title: German Market (DACH) Email Support VA - Shopify Cat Supplement Brand
description:
GERMAN MARKET (DACH)
 SUPPORT VA - SHOPIFY CAT SUPPLEMENT BRAND

Remote | Part-time, about 2-3 hours per day (growing) | Start: ASAP | $3 - $5 per hour



READ THIS FIRST



This job post is long and this application will take you 30 to 45 minutes. That is on purpose.



I am hiring ONE person. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 lazy ones. If you send the same message to 40 job posts a day, close this now - you will not get through.



But please do not be scared off either. You will not be thrown into deep water alone. We have fixed SOPs (written step-by-step instructions) for every situation, I will train you, and we have a 1-on-1 call every single week. You do not need to invent anything. You need to be reliable, careful, and willing to learn our system.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.



THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT - READ BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE



We sell in the DACH market: Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Our customers write to us in German.



You MUST have already done
 support for the German-speaking market. This is requirement number one and there is no exception to it. If you have only supported US, UK, AU or general English-speaking customers, this job is not for you and you will not be selected.



You do not have to be a fluent German speaker. The workflow is:



1. TRANSLATE the incoming German

2. UNDERSTAND what the customer actually wants

3. ANSWER using our SOP and our German templates



But you must have done this before. German-speaking customers communicate differently from American ones - more direct, more formal, more focused on facts and rules. Someone who has never worked this market gets the tone wrong, and that costs us customers. People who have done it already know exactly what I mean.



THE BIG IDEA



We are building the most trusted cat supplement brand in the DACH market.



We currently do six figures per month and we are scaling with paid ads.



Here is why this role matters more than a normal support job: our whole business model is built on customer lifetime value. Acquiring a new customer through ads is expensive. The profit is not in the first order - it is in the second, the fifth and the tenth. A customer who stays with us for a year is worth many times more than one who buys once and leaves.



Support is the single biggest lever on that number. A cat owner whose problem you solved quickly and kindly reorders. One who felt ignored never comes back, and everything we paid to acquire them is lost.



So you are not "answering tickets". You are directly responsible for how long our customers stay with us, and that is one of the most valuable jobs in the company.



A business is also like a house. Most people only build the front - the ads, the product page, the pretty pictures. Then the first storm comes and it falls over, because there is no foundation. The foundation is the backend. That is what you are.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Customer
s (your main job)

- Translate, understand and answer all incoming customer
s using our SOPs and templates

- Typical topics: order status, "where is my package", product and dosage questions, complaints, refund requests, address problems

- Keep the inbox at zero. No
 older than 24 hours.



2. Cases and disputes

- Handle and solve PayPal disputes, chargebacks and Shopify cases: respond to the case, upload tracking and evidence, write the response



3. Address problems

- You will be in the WhatsApp group with our supplier. When the supplier reports that an address is wrong, incomplete or undeliverable, you take it from there: you
 the customer, get the correct address, update it in Shopify, and confirm back to the supplier.

- I should not have to sit in the middle of that. You are the link.



4. Talking to the supply chain (this is important to me)

- You do not just fix problems for the customer - you push them back up the chain so they stop happening.

- Example: if packages arrive damaged, you do not simply send a replacement and move on. You tell the supplier: this is the second damaged package this week, here are the photos, why is this happening and what will you change?

- You document everything: what went wrong, how often, which orders. Then you bring it to our weekly call so we can actually fix the root cause.

- If 10 customers this week asked the same question, that is not 10 tickets - that is one broken product page, and I want to know.



To be clear about what this job is NOT: you do not order stock, you do not manage inventory, you do not do purchasing. You handle customers, cases, and communication with the supplier when something goes wrong.



STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Here is the first filter:



The very first word of your application message must be PINEAPPLE.



Not in the middle. Not at the end. The first word, on its own line, before anything else. Like this:



PINEAPPLE



Hi Erik, ...



If your message does not start with PINEAPPLE, I will not read it - no matter how good your experience is. This is not a joke and I will not make an exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.



ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part I care about most, so I am going to be very clear.



I am not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. I have zero problem with any of that.



What I have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if something happens in your family, if you simply cannot work today - send me one message. Before, not after. That is all I ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Disappearing without a word is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because I am strict about hours, but because I cannot run a business on someone I have to chase.



Beyond that, I expect:

- You work independently. You do not need to be reminded or micromanaged.

- You speak up. If something is unclear, if a process is broken, if you think I am wrong - say it. Preferably in our weekly call.

- You represent the brand positively, in every
 and in the supplier group. You are the face of this company to our customers.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements - no exceptions)



1. Proven
 support experience for the DACH market (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). You must be able to name the stores or companies. This is the number one requirement.



2. Experience handling PayPal disputes and chargebacks. You must be able to describe a real case you worked on and how it ended.



3. Solid general computer skills. You can work confidently with a browser, several tools at once, translation tools, spreadsheets and a helpdesk inbox. You can take a German
, translate it properly, find the order, apply the right SOP and send a clean answer - without getting lost.



4. Hands-on experience with Shopify: finding orders, editing shipping addresses, issuing refunds, arranging re-shipments.



5. Good written English. English is how you and I communicate, and how you talk to our supplier. It does not need to be perfect literature, but it must be clear and professional.



6. Strong, stable internet connection and a working computer.



7. Available on WhatsApp for supplier and team communication.



8. Willing to sign a freelance contract and an NDA (a short agreement that you will not share our supplier, our numbers or our customer data with anyone) before you get access to our systems.



BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of my list)



- Experience in the pet niche, especially pet supplements. If you have done DACH
 support for a cat or dog supplement brand, you are exactly who I am looking for.

- Experience with helpdesk tools. Tell me which ones you have actually used - Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, Commslayer, anything. I want to know what you can already work with, because it means you start faster.

- Any tool that makes you faster: translation tools, AI tools, text expanders, order lookup tools. Tell me your setup.

- Experience moderating comments and answering 
 on
 or Instagram ads.



TOOLS WE USE



Shopify, Commslayer, Gmail, PayPal, WhatsApp, Google Sheets



WORKING HOURS AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- 100% remote, from anywhere in the Philippines

- Right now: about 2 hours per day, sometimes up to 3 when volume is high. Roughly 10 to 15 hours per week.

- The hours depend on how much comes in. Quiet days you are done in an hour. After a big ad push it takes longer. You are paid per hour, so this works both ways - I am not going to pretend it is a fixed 40-hour job today.

- Where this is going: we are scaling. The workload will grow, and the plan is to turn this into a full-time position for the right person. If you are that person, you grow into it - more hours, more responsibility, more pay.

- You choose when you work. The only rule: every customer
 answered within 24 hours, and you check the inbox at least twice per day, including a short check on weekends.

- 1-on-1 call every Friday, fixed. We go through the numbers, the recurring problems, what you need from me, and what you can improve. I will give you direct feedback and I expect you to use it. This is a team, not a hierarchy - I want your opinion.

- English is our working language.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



1. First response time - under 24 hours, always

2. Inbox zero at the end of your working day

3. Cases, disputes and address problems solved without me stepping in

4. Customer lifetime value - customers who had a problem still reorder

5. Communication - I always know where you are

6. Problems that get documented and actually fixed at the source



COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



You are paid per hour, for the hours you actually work.



Step 1 - Paid trial: $2.50 per hour. Real tickets, real customers, from day one. You are paid for every hour of it. Short, and I d
 quickly.

Step 2 - Approved: $3 per hour. The position is yours.

Step 3 - Proven and long-term: $4 per hour.

Step 4 - Fully operating, running the whole thing on your own: up to $5 per hour.



At roughly 10 to 15 hours per week that is about $130 to $270 per month today - and both the hours and the rate grow as we scale. I move people up this ladder fast when they earn it. I have never lost a great person over money and I do not plan to start.



Also included:

- Paid monthly, on time, via Wise or PayPal

- 13th month bonus after one full year

- Bonuses when the business does well - when we grow, you grow

- All tools and software licences paid by us

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- Freelance contract and NDA

- Long-term position - I want someone who grows with the brand



One honest note: at today's hours this is a part-time income. If you currently work with another client, that is completely fine with me, as long as our
s are always answered within 24 hours. As we scale, this role is meant to become your main one.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph.



Start your message exactly as instructed earlier in this post. If you skipped that part, go back and read it - I will know.



Then answer all 6 questions. Be specific - vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. DACH EXPERIENCE. Which companies or stores have you done German-market
 support for? For each: the name, the niche, how long, roughly how many
s per day, and your average first response time. Numbers, not adjectives. If you have no DACH experience, please do not apply.



2. PROOF OF EXPERIENCE. Show me something real from your past support work: an SOP you followed or wrote, a template library, a screenshot of your ticket stats, or a reference I can contact. Remove or black out anything confidential - I do not want you to break an agreement with a past employer. If you cannot share anything, write a short SOP for us instead: "Customer writes that the package never arrived. Step by step, what do you do?"



3. DISPUTES. Describe one PayPal dispute or chargeback you personally handled. What was the situation, what evidence did you upload, what did you write, and how did it end?



4. THE REAL TEST. A customer writes to us, in German:

"Das ist jetzt das DRITTE Mal, dass ich schreibe. Ich habe vor 3 Wochen bestellt und die Sendungsverfolgung bewegt sich seit 10 Tagen nicht. Meine Katze hat kein Supplement mehr. Entweder ihr schickt es heute raus oder ich mache eine Rueckbuchung und hinterlasse ueberall eine Bewertung."

Write the actual reply you would send this customer, in German. Do not describe what you would do - write the
.



5. THE SUPPLIER SIDE. Our supplier messages the WhatsApp group: "Order #1043 address incomplete, no house number, cannot ship, need answer today." Tell me step by step what you do, in what order, and what exactly you write to the customer and to the supplier.



6. YOUR SETUP AND YOUR SITUATION. Which tools and software do you already work with daily (helpdesk, translation, Shopify, anything that makes you faster)? When can you start? Are you okay with about 2-3 hours per day at the start and the paid trial at $2.50 per hour? Add a link to your CV (your resume) and a link to a 60-second Loom or voice recording where you introduce yourself in English.



Applications that do not start correctly, or that skip any of the 6 questions, will not be reviewed. I am strict about this on purpose - following instructions exactly is the single most important part of this job.



I read every application that follows the instructions, and I reply fast.



If this sounds like you, apply today. I am hiring one person and I am hiring quickly.

title: COLD OUTBOUND COMMERCIAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE
description:
# COLD OUTBOUND COMMERCIAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE



### Remote | Philippines | Central Minnesota Market | Performance-Based Opportunity



**Edge Services Window Cleaning** is a growing window cleaning company based in St. Cloud, Minnesota. We primarily serve Central Minnesota and are looking to add a highly motivated **outbound commercial sales representative** to our team.



This is **not a typical VA position.**



We are not looking for someone whose job is simply to send 100 messages a day or book appointments that never turn into anything.



We are looking for someone who understands **outbound sales** and can help us build a repeatable system for acquiring commercial customers.



Our goal is simple:



**Find businesses that need window cleaning ? get in front of the right decision makers ? create genuine interest ? generate qualified opportunities ? help close the work ? build recurring commercial revenue.**



And we want to learn from the person we hire along the way.



---



## ABOUT EDGE SERVICES



Edge Services is a growing window cleaning company located in **St. Cloud, Minnesota**.



We have built our business primarily through residential window cleaning and are now looking to significantly expand our **recurring commercial customer base**.



Our long-term goal is not to build a company based on one-time jobs.



We want to develop a strong base of recurring customers that provides stability for our team and allows us to continue growing.



We believe there is a significant opportunity to build a commercial sales system around this.



**That's where you come in.**



---



# WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with real experience in:



* B2B outbound sales

* Cold outreach

* Lead generation

* Prospect research

* Finding decision makers

* Cold

* Cold calling

* LinkedIn outreach

*
/social media outreach

* Sales follow-up

* Appointment setting

* Lead qualification

* Closing or assisting with closing

* Building outbound sales systems



You do **not** need to have experience selling window cleaning.



In fact, we are more interested in your ability to **figure out how to sell** than whether you've worked in our exact industry.



If you have experience building outbound campaigns from scratch and can explain **why something works**, we want to talk to you.



---



# THE BIGGER PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION



There is an important reason we are hiring this role.



We don't simply want to hire someone to perform sales tasks forever.



We want to **learn what actually works.**



We want to discover:



* Which industries are easiest to sell

* Which types of businesses make the best customers

* Who the actual decision makers are

* Which outreach channels produce results

* Whether cold
 works

* Whether LinkedIn works

* Whether
 works

* Whether cold calling works

* What messaging gets responses

* What offers get businesses interested

* How many follow-ups are necessary

* What objections businesses have

* Why businesses switch window cleaners

* What makes businesses agree to recurring service

* Which sales tools are worth paying for

* Which parts of the process can eventually be automated with AI



We want to **test, measure, learn, document, and improve.**



If you have strong outbound sales experience, we want you to bring your ideas to the table.



You won't simply be told:



> "Send 50
s today."



We want you to be able to say:



> "I think this type of business is a better target, here's why, here's how I would reach them, here's what I would test, and here's how we'll know if it's working."



---



# OUR IDEAL CUSTOMERS



Our primary market is **commercial businesses within approximately 45 minutes of St. Cloud, Minnesota.**



We care about **route density**, so we want to build clusters of customers that make sense for our technicians to service.



We are especially interested in recurring storefront/commercial accounts in approximately the **$100–$700/month range**, although larger opportunities are welcome.



Some of the businesses we want to explore include:



### High-Priority Prospects



* Restaurants

* Cafés / food businesses

* Banks

* Medical offices

* Dental offices

* Retail storefronts

* Car dealerships

* Gyms

* Grocery stores

* Property management companies

* Churches

* Office buildings



We especially want to explore businesses where windows need to be cleaned **monthly, quarterly, or even weekly.**



For example, a busy restaurant that needs weekly storefront cleaning could potentially be a much better customer than a large building that only wants cleaning once per year.



**We want you to help us figure out which customers are actually the best.**



---



# WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



You will help manage the entire outbound sales process.



### 1. BUILD PROSPECT LISTS



Research businesses in our service area and build targeted prospect lists.



Potential sources may include:



* Google Maps

* Business directories

* LinkedIn

*

* Company websites

* Local business organizations

* Other prospecting/data tools



You will identify:



* Business name

* Location

* Website

* Phone number

* Decision maker

* Decision maker's position

*

* LinkedIn/social profile when available

* Type of business

* Potential cleaning frequency

* Potential value

* Notes about the opportunity



We want **quality prospects**, not just huge spreadsheets.



---



### 2. FIND THE RIGHT PERSON



A major part of the job will be figuring out:



**Who actually makes the decision about window cleaning?**



Depending on the business, that might be:



* Owner

* General manager

* Property manager

* Facility manager

* Operations manager

* Office manager

* Maintenance manager



You should be comfortable figuring this out rather than simply sending a generic message to the business.



---



### 3. TEST MULTIPLE OUTBOUND CHANNELS



We are **not assuming cold calling is the answer.**



If cold calling works, we will use it.



If LinkedIn works better, we'll use LinkedIn.



If
 works, we'll use
.



If
 works, we'll use
.



If something completely different works, we want to know about it.



You will help test different approaches and track the results.



---



### 4. CREATE REAL CONVERSATIONS



We don't want meaningless appointments.



We want businesses that actually have a reason to talk to us.



A great opportunity might sound like:



> "We currently have someone cleaning our windows, but we're not happy with their service."



Or:



> "We've been meaning to find someone who can clean our storefront every month."



Or:



> "Send me a quote. We'd like to compare pricing."



Or:



> "Come take a look at the property and give us a proposal."



Those are the kinds of opportunities we care about.



---



### 5. QUALIFY THE OPPORTUNITY



Before handing a prospect to us, you should learn as much as possible.



For example:



* What type of business is it?

* Who is the decision maker?

* What windows need cleaning?

* How frequently do they want service?

* Do they currently use another company?

* Are they unhappy with their current provider?

* When were the windows last cleaned?

* Are they interested in recurring service?

* What is their approximate scope?

* Is an on-site visit necessary?

* Can photos/information be collected remotely?

* When are they expecting a proposal?



The better you qualify the opportunity, the more valuable the lead is.



---



### 6. HELP MOVE THE SALE FORWARD



You won't necessarily hand us a lead and disappear.



We want you to help move qualified opportunities toward becoming customers.



For smaller opportunities, you may collect the necessary information/photos so we can prepare a quote.



For larger opportunities, you may schedule an on-site estimate with us.



You may also follow up with the prospect after we send the proposal.



**The goal is not an appointment.**



The goal is:



### **A HAPPY CUSTOMER WHO HIRES EDGE SERVICES.**



---



# WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We will track your work every day.



Your daily report will include numbers such as:



* Prospects researched

*
s sent

* Calls made

* LinkedIn messages

*
/social outreach

* Conversations

* Qualified leads

* Estimates requested

* Follow-ups

* Jobs closed

* Revenue generated

* Follow-ups due the next day



For example:



**Daily Report**



Prospects researched: 40

s sent: 30

Calls: 50

LinkedIn messages: 20

Conversations: 8

Qualified leads: 3

Estimates requested: 2

Jobs closed: 0

Revenue generated: $0

Follow-ups due tomorrow: 12



The exact activity targets will be developed with the right candidate based on the sales strategy we determine.



---



# WE CARE ABOUT RESULTS — NOT BUSY WORK



We don't want someone who can make a spreadsheet look impressive.



We want someone who can generate **revenue**.



There is a huge difference between:



> "I booked 10 appointments."



and:



> "I generated 10 qualified opportunities, 6 received estimates, 3 became customers, and those customers are worth $1,400/month in recurring revenue."



**We care much more about the second person.**



---



# PERFORMANCE-BASED COMPENSATION



We are budgeting approximately **$500/month toward the initial labor component**, with significant opportunity for additional compensation based on the business you help generate.



A large part of the long-term compensation opportunity will be tied to **successful sales and revenue generated.**



We are still developing the exact commission structure because we want to make sure it rewards the right behavior.



We are much more interested in creating a compensation plan where a great salesperson can make **meaningfully more money by producing meaningful revenue** than simply paying someone a fixed hourly rate.



For the right person, there is significant upside.



---



# THIS IS A RESULTS-DRIVEN ROLE



We want to see results quickly.



The first couple of weeks will be extremely important.



We expect the person we hire to:



* Start prospecting quickly

* Test multiple approaches

* Generate real conversations

* Learn from objections

* Track results

* Adjust their strategy

* Identify promising industries

* Identify what isn't working

* Begin generating qualified opportunities



If someone spends two weeks sending messages without learning anything, changing anything, or generating meaningful opportunities, this probably isn't going to be a good fit.



We would rather quickly identify that the strategy or person isn't working and make a change.



---



# WHAT MAKES SOMEONE EXCELLENT AT THIS JOB?



You may be a great fit if you are someone who:



* Has genuine B2B sales experience

* Has done cold outreach before

* Understands prospecting

* Is comfortable talking to business owners

* Isn't afraid of rejection

* Knows how to research prospects

* Understands sales psychology

* Can write persuasive messages

* Can communicate professionally

* Is highly organized

* Tracks numbers

* Thinks analytically

* Tests different approaches

* Learns quickly

* Takes initiative

* Can explain why a strategy should work

* Doesn't need to be told every step

* Cares about actual results



Most importantly:



### **You need to think like a salesperson, not just a VA.**



---



# BONUS: EXPERIENCE WITH THESE TOOLS



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Apollo

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* Hunter

* Instantly

* Smartlead

* Phantombuster

* Google Maps prospecting

* CRM systems

*
 automation

* Lead scraping/data tools

* AI sales tools

* Claude

* ChatGPT

* Other outbound sales platforms



You do **not** need experience with every tool.



We're much more interested in whether you understand **how to use tools to create a sales system.**



---



# THE LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This position could grow significantly for the right person.



Our long-term vision is to build a commercial sales system that is:



**Repeatable ? Measurable ? Documented ? Scalable ? AI-assisted**



We believe AI may eventually be able to handle a significant portion of the prospect research, list building, personalization, follow-up, and administrative work.



But before we automate something, we need to understand **what actually works.**



That is one of the reasons this position is so important.



We want to find someone who can help us build the system first.



If you help us discover a highly effective commercial sales process, there may be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities within the company as we grow.



---



# AN EXAMPLE OF WHAT SUCCESS COULD LOOK LIKE



Imagine that six months from now:



We have discovered that medical offices, grocery stores, and restaurants are our best commercial customers.



We know exactly who to contact.



We know which messages work.



We know which channels work.



We have a repeatable follow-up system.



We are generating 15+ qualified commercial opportunities per month.



We are adding thousands of dollars in recurring commercial revenue.



The entire process is documented.



And a large portion of the prospecting and follow-up process can eventually be handled by AI and software.



**We want you to help us build that system.**



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please do **not** send us a generic application saying:



> "I am hardworking, motivated, and can do this job."



We want to understand your actual sales experience.



Please answer the following questions:



### 1.



Tell us about the most successful outbound sales campaign you have personally worked on.



What were you selling, who were you targeting, and what results did you produce?



### 2.



If you were starting from zero and had to find commercial window-cleaning customers within 45 minutes of St. Cloud, Minnesota, how would you find your first 100 prospects?



### 3.



Which 3 types of businesses would you test first and why?



### 4.



What outreach channels would you test first?



### 5.



Give us an example of a cold outreach message you would send to a local business owner.



### 6.



How would you identify the person who makes the decision about window cleaning?



### 7.



What would your first 7 days look like?



Please give us actual numbers for things such as prospect research, calls,
s, messages, follow-ups, etc.



### 8.



How do you determine whether an outbound sales campaign is working?



### 9.



Tell us about a time when a sales strategy wasn't working. What did you change?



### 10.



What sales tools have you personally used?



### 11.



What do you believe separates a **qualified sales opportunity** from a meaningless appointment?



### 12.



If we gave you $500/month and told you that your goal was to generate recurring commercial revenue, how would you approach it?



### 13.



What part of outbound sales do you think AI can already do well, and what parts still require a human salesperson?



---



## IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who wants to **build something**, not someone who simply wants to complete a list of daily tasks.



If you have real outbound sales experience and believe you can help a small business build a predictable commercial customer acquisition system, **we want to hear from you.**



**Apply with detailed answers to the questions above.**



We will prioritize candidates who demonstrate actual sales knowledge, strategic thinking, and measurable results.

title: Ecom video editor
description:
I run a dropshipping business and I'm constantly testing new products — roughly 2 per week. Each product needs 5–10 videos, so there is a high and consistent volume of work for the right person. The products are usually small items varying from toys, gadgets, health and beauty devices, general household items, bathroom/kitchen gadgets/devices, small outdoor devices, etc.



Target audience is primarily USA, thus you will need to have a very good understanding of American English.



Video lengths vary widely. When starting off testing a product I am using only 3–7 min VSLs. Sometimes a few short form UGC style videos.



If there is success with a particular product that has been tested, we will be moving onto the second stage which is scaling the product. This will require extra video adverts being produced, which includes:



Making a wide variety of content styles: UGC, short form, long form, etc.

Producing video ads with new angles

Re-editing already existing video to produce the same VSL just with different hooks, or perhaps changing certain parts of the video to target other audiences.



Most importantly I am looking for:



- Creativity, especially for the opening hook: Looking for a creative who can concept pattern-interrupt video hooks — pairing unexpected visuals with emotionally charged headlines to stop cold traffic dead. To apply, send me 3 hook concepts (headline + visual) for a luck and fortune bracelet. The bracelet is sold to older Americans who feel like their luck has run out and are looking for something to change their fortune. I'm looking for ideas that have nothing to do with bracelets but everything to do with how the audience feels.



- Attention to detail: Read the full script before you start editing. If the script says "I woke up gasping for air" — find a clip of someone waking up gasping. If it says "my doctor told me my X-rays were normal" — find a doctor's office clip. The footage should match what is being said at that exact 
nt. Not random b-roll thrown over a voiceover. If you watch the finished video and the clips make logical sense with the words — you've done it right.



- Proactivity: I am not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. If you notice the pacing is off, fix it. If you think a different clip would work better, use it and tell me why. If you have an idea for a stronger hook than the one in the script, pitch it. I want someone who treats the video like its their own project, not a checklist.



- Personality: I'm not looking for safe videos, or boring ones. The right video editor is someone who sees a product that helps people sleep better and immediately thinks — what if we show a car crash. I want ideas that make normal people uncomfortable but make the right people laugh and say "that's genius." If you always colour inside the lines, this is not the job for you.

-------------------------



What I'll provide:



Written script

All product media (photos, video, animated assets)

Website link for full product context

Note: I do not provide talking head footage or AI-generated voiceovers. You'll need to source or create these yourself.



What you'll be doing:



Really understand the product — not just cut to the script, but think creatively about which visuals, clips, and angles will make someone stop scrolling

Create high-quality, scroll-stopping opening clips — the hook is everything

Source or generate talking head characters with accurate lip sync — this is a hard requirement

Use AI-generated content where it makes sense and adds quality — you have full creative freedom here

Occasionally: take a competitor-style video with a new script and fully remake it with fresh visuals and a slightly modified angle

You must be able to:



Produce accurate lip sync

Work with UGC, talking head and hybrid formats

Source or generate voiceovers

Use AI tools confidently

Handle fast turnaround at volume

Think like a marketer, not just an editor



Example of video work I'm looking for:

 



-------------------------

SALARY



If you're genuinely good and we work well together, I will pay you properly — and in the long run there is very good earning potential here given the volume of work. But I'm not putting someone on a full monthly salary when I don't yet know what they can do. We'll start with a fixed payment for a small batch of videos — say 5 for one product. If the work is strong and we both want to continue, we move to a monthly arrangement and negotiate from there based on quality, volume and turnaround time.



Please do not send me:

Canva CVs, resumes, or AI generated job applications and messages. I am not interested. 



Please send me your Google Drive link with your previous VSL work.

title: Client Account Manager – Digital Advertising & Gaming
description:
Client Account Manager – Digital Advertising & Gaming



Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours / overnight Philippines schedule

Employment: Full Time, Long Term

Compensation: $3,000 USD per month



This Is More Than a Remote Job:



If you are already good at working with U.S. clients and are ready for a role where your communication, personality, judgment, and ideas actually matter, this may be the opportunity you have been looking for.



Workspark is hiring a Client Account Manager to work full time with an innovative U.S. media company helping major brands reach audiences inside gaming and emerging digital platforms.



You will not sit quietly behind the scenes.



You will become one of the people clients know, trust, and rely on.



You will work directly with U.S. agencies and brands, guide advertising campaigns from kickoff through final results, communicate with internal specialists, and become the person clients turn to when they need an answer, an update, or simply confidence that everything is under control.



This is not a sales role.



You do not need gaming experience.



You do need strong digital advertising knowledge, exceptional English, excellent people skills, and the confidence to represent a U.S. company professionally with sophisticated clients.



If you are looking for a long-term career where you can grow into meaningful client ownership instead of simply completing tasks, keep reading.



What You Will Do:

- Become a primary day-to-day contact for U.S. agency and brand clients after an advertising campaign has been sold.

- Guide clients through campaign kickoff, timelines, approvals, launches, updates, reporting, and final wrap-up.

- Participate in and increasingly lead client meetings.

- Communicate regularly through Slack,
, and video calls.

- Gather information from internal specialists and turn it into clear, polished, client-friendly communication.

- Make sure client questions are acknowledged quickly and followed through until resolved.

- Recognize when a request is urgent and make sure the right internal people know immediately.

- Help keep clients aligned on deadlines, approvals, deliverables, and changing campaign requirements.

- Work with reporting and data teams to understand campaign performance and communicate the story behind the results.

- Maintain organized account notes, campaign information, client requests, I/O details, and next steps.

- Build toward managing approximately 5–10 active campaigns across multiple client relationships.

- Learn how advertising works inside platforms such as Fortnite, Roblox, and other emerging digital environments.

- Recognize opportunities for additional client business and pass those signals to the sales team.



What We Need You to Bring:



We are not looking for someone we need to teach how to communicate with clients.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to do that well.



You should have:

- Approximately 2–4+ years of relevant experience in digital advertising, media, marketing, account management, client services, campaign management, media planning, ad operations, or a similar field.

- Direct experience working with clients, preferably U.S. clients, agencies, advertisers, or brands.

- Excellent spoken English with the confidence to participate naturally in fast-moving client conversations.

- Exceptional written English for professional Slack and
 communication.

- Working knowledge of advertising concepts such as CPM, CPC, impressions, campaign flight dates, reporting, and Insertion Orders.

- Experience helping manage advertising or marketing campaigns from planning through completion.

- The ability to understand campaign performance and explain results clearly to a client.

- Strong organizational skills across multiple accounts, deadlines, approvals, and client requests.

- Comfort using Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides.

- Experience with tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Asana, 
, or similar CRM/project-management systems is helpful.



The Person Who Will Thrive Here:



Technical knowledge matters.



But for this position, how you work with people matters just as much.



You will probably be a strong fit if:

- You are naturally warm, confident, and easy to talk to.

- You communicate clearly without sounding scripted or robotic.

- You understand when something needs attention now instead of tomorrow.

- You do not avoid uncomfortable conversations.

- You can tell a client difficult news without damaging the relationship.

- You are comfortable speaking up with internal teams when something needs to move.

- You ask smart questions and remember the answers.

- You enjoy learning and becoming more independent over time.

- You stay calm when priorities change.

- You notice what a client is worried about even when they do not say it directly.

- You take ownership instead of waiting for someone to chase you.



**Most importantly, clients should feel better after speaking with you.**



You Do Not Need Gaming Experience



If you have never worked with Fortnite, Roblox, or gaming advertising, that is completely fine.



The company will teach you its products, platforms, systems, and processes.



What cannot easily be taught is excellent communication, curiosity, judgment, responsiveness, and the ability to make clients trust you.



That is what we are hiring for.



Where This Role Can Take You:



At the beginning, you will receive significant support while learning the company's campaigns, clients, products, and systems.



As you develop, the expectation is that you will take increasing ownership of important client relationships.



The goal is for you to become someone leadership trusts to independently handle major accounts because clients know you, enjoy working with you, and know that you will get things done.



This is intended to be a career position, not a short-term remote assignment.



Why Workspark:



You will be a full-time Workspark employee working directly with one of our U.S. client companies.



Workspark focuses on long-term international careers with strong U.S. companies. We recruit specifically for each position rather than placing people into temporary projects.



You can expect:

- $3,000 USD monthly salary.

- Full-time, long-term employment.

- Direct exposure to U.S. agency and brand clients.

- Meaningful client-facing responsibility.

- Training on an emerging area of digital advertising.

- Opportunity to grow into ownership of important accounts.

- Bi-monthly payroll via Wise.

- Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave after the probationary period.

- Ongoing Workspark HR and employee support.



Important Schedule Requirement:



This position works during U.S. Eastern Time business hours, which means an overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Please apply only if you have successfully worked overnight or U.S. hours before and are comfortable maintaining that schedule long term.



For this role, being alert, responsive, personable, and client-ready throughout the U.S. workday is essential.



Technical Requirements:

- Reliable high-speed internet.

- Reliable backup power solution.

- Functional webcam and professional headset.

- Quiet, professional home working environment.

- Reliable availability throughout the required U.S. schedule.



How to Apply:

Follow this link 
, please be prepared to submit:

- Your updated resume.

- A short video or audio introduction in English.



In your video introduction, tell us:

1 - What kinds of advertising, marketing, or media clients you have supported.

2 - What you personally owned in those client relationships.

3 - Tell us about one difficult or urgent client situation you handled successfully.



We are looking for someone who is excellent at their job and someone clients genuinely enjoy working with.

If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

 open, click and response rates

 campaign you created or managed

PAID SKILLS TEST



Final candidates may be asked to complete a short paid test consisting of:

 post for homeowners who are remodeling

 post targeting contractors

EMPLOYMENT TERMS



This position will begin with a paid 30-day trial. Candidates who produce reliable, high-quality work and measurable results may be offered a long-term position with additional hours and responsibilities.



Please do not apply if you only schedule posts and cannot demonstrate experience with lead generation,
 marketing and performance tracking.

title: Temu, TikTok Shop, Etsy, and Shopify Product Listing & SEO Specialist

We specialize in personalized products, custo
tal signs, business signage, home décor, and made-to-order items for the United States market. The ideal candidate must understand how to market personalized products and write natural, persuasive content for American customers.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Create and optimize product listings for Temu, TikTok Shop, Etsy, and Shopify

* Conduct keyword and competitor research for the U.S. market

* Write SEO-optimized product titles, descriptions, tags, and keywords

* Experience creating and optimizing listings for personalized or made-to-order products

* Strong knowledge of SEO, keyword research, and the U.S. e-commerce market

* Experience creating A+ Content or enhanced product content

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

* Ability to follow instructions, meet deadlines, and work independently

title: Full Stack and Mobile Developer, AI and Integrations
description:
We are an internationally operating digital marketing agency working with clients across different countries and industries.

Develop responsive web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js.

Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Build backend functionality using Node.js and/or Python.

Work with Claude Code, Cursor or comparable AI assisted development tools.

Improve prototype and AI generated code before it is used in production.

Debug technical issues and take responsibility for the reliability of what you deliver.

Write clean, tested and maintainable code.

Use Git and GitHub professionally and contribute to code reviews.

Communicate progress, challenges and technical decisions clearly.



Essential skills and experience

At least 2 years of professional experience in full stack development.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills.

Professional experience with React and preferably Next.js.

Professional mobile development experience with React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Backend development experience with Node.js and/or Python.

Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and third party services.

Good understanding of databases, data modelling and SQL.

Ability to connect frontend, backend, mobile applications, databases and external platforms.

Experience with Git, GitHub and modern deployment workflows.

Hands on experience building AI features, agents, integrations or automations using Claude, ChatGPT or similar APIs.

Strong debugging, logical thinking and problem solving skills.

Ability to work confidently within existing codebases.



Communication and working style

Strong spoken and written English is essential. Our agency works internationally, and you will communicate with team members and potentially clients from different countries.

You should be someone who:

Communicates clearly and professionally.

Takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

Thinks logically and understands the wider objective behind a task.

Raises questions or potential problems early.

Provides transparent progress updates.

Works independently while remaining closely connected to the team.

Is dependable and follows through on agreed responsibilities.

Is open to feedback and interested in continuously improving.

You do not need to be based in Europe, but you must be able to provide reliable overlap with European working hours for communication, collaboration and scheduled meetings.

Previous experience within a digital agency, startup or international remote team.

Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar development tools.

PostgreSQL, Supabase or comparable database technologies.

Vercel and cloud deployment.

n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

Google APIs, SEO platforms, analytics tools or reporting dashboards.

Data extraction and web scraping.

Figma and a basic understanding of UX and responsive design.

Whether you are applying for a part time or full time position.

* A creative mindset — you don't just execute tasks, you also come up with ideas.

We don't just want a database with thousands of company names. We are looking for someone who can turn research into real B2B relationships and sales.

* Number of relevant retailers identified.

* Number of qualified retailers contacted.

* New B2B portal registrations.

* New active B2B customers and orders.

* Consistent monthly
 campaigns.

* Quality and accuracy of our B2B database.

Who are we looking for?



You might be a great fit if you enjoy researching companies online, finding new commercial opportunities and turning cold prospects into customers.



You are comfortable taking ownership. If you notice something on the B2B portal that could be improved, you take action. If a retailer doesn't respond to the first
, you follow up. If you discover a promising new retail segment, you investigate it.

Fit

Contract / freelance preferred. Remote. You’ll collaborate with a small team that already has systems, combat, and art packs in place — we need someone who makes the world look alive for players.

MILESTONE 1 — BUILD (Weeks 1-3): Set up and optimize TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn. Build ManyChat (or similar) automation: comment triggers, auto-DM flows, and lead capture into our CRM/sheet. Produce the first batch of AI content (Claude scripts + AI avatar videos — no filming). This milestone is also your probation. Quality d

MILESTONE 3 — PROVE (Weeks 6-10): Optimize to a cost per lead and cost per booked client that beats our current paid lead source. Weekly numbers reports: spend, leads, cost per lead, booked clients.

AFTER HANDOFF: Optional on-call maintenance retainer, paid per session or a small monthly fee.



NON-NEGOTIABLES:



- We pay for and own ALL tools and accounts. Everything is built inside OUR logins from day one.

- Payment per completed, WORKING milestone, verified by us. No hourly billing.

- We run modern: AI content and automation, not manual posting and manual DM answering.

- Proof required with your application: past ad campaign results (redacted is fine) and an automation flow you personally built.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL 6 QUESTIONS. Vague answers are auto-rejected:



1. Describe a lead gen system you built for a local service business (cleaning, HVAC, plumbing, etc.): platform, budget, cost per lead, and what happened after handoff. Real numbers.

title: Senior Native Ads Creative Strategist / Direct Response Copywriter
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Native Ads Creative Strategist / Direct Response Copywriter to join our team and help us build high-performing native creatives for a supplement brand in the US.



This is NOT a junior role.



We need someone who understands that a native ad is not just an image with some copy underneath it.



You need to understand the psychology behind why someone stops scrolling, reads the first line, continues reading, becomes curious about the mechanism, and eventually clicks.



Your job will be to research markets, identify angles, develop concepts, create native images, write primary copy, analyze competitors, and continuously improve creatives based on performance.



What we’re looking for:



* 2+ years of experience in Direct Response, Native Ads, advertorials or performance marketing

* Strong experience working with supplement, health or wellness brands

* Deep understanding of Eugene Schwartz / Breakthrough Advertising principles

* Strong understanding of Market Sophistication and Customer Awareness Levels

* Ability to identify what stage a market is currently in and adapt messaging accordingly

* Ability to conduct deep customer and market research independently

* Strong competitor research skills

* Ability to analyze competitor ads, advertorials, funnels, angles, hooks, mechanisms and offers

* Ability to identify patterns across winning creatives instead of blindly copying competitors

* Ability to discover new angles and creative opportunities that competitors are not using yet

* Strong understanding of direct response psychology

* Ability to create native-style image concepts that actually look native to the platform

* Ability to generate and source images independently

* Experience using AI tools for image generation and creative production

* Ability to write high-performing primary text for Meta ads

* Ability to write hooks that create curiosity without sounding like obvious advertising

* Ability to develop problem-aware, solution-aware and mechanism-focused angles

* Ability to turn customer research into strong creative concepts

* Ability to understand why a creative should work before launching it



AI is part of the workflow.



We expect you to know how to use tools such as Claude for:



* Research

* Angle development

* Hook generation

* Copy development

* Customer avatar research

* Competitor analysis

* Creative ideation



But we are NOT looking for someone who simply asks Claude to write an ad and copies the output.



You need to be able to judge the output yourself.



You should be able to recognize weak copy, rewrite it, sharpen the hook, improve the argument, remove unnecessary language and turn an average AI-generated draft into a strong direct response ad.



You need to understand copy well enough to improve AI — not depend on it.



Research will be a major part of your role.



You should be comfortable researching:



* Customer reviews

* Reddit

* Amazon

* Competitor websites

* Meta Ad Library

* Advertorials

* VSLs

* Landing pages

* Customer language

* Pain points

* Desires

* Objections

* Failed solutions

* Existing beliefs

* Unique mechanisms

* Market sophistication

* Competitor positioning



From that research, you should be able to create completely new angles, hooks and native ad concepts.



We want someone who can produce primary texts that make us immediately want to test them.



Not generic AI copy.



Not rewritten competitor ads.



Not surface-level hooks.



We want strong Direct Response thinking.



You should constantly be asking:



Why would someone stop here?



Why would they keep reading?



What belief are we changing?



What is the customer already aware of?



What have they already tried?



What does the market already promise?



How can we say something different?



What is the mechanism?



Where is the curiosity?



Where is the proof?



Why should they believe us?



You will also work closely with our creative team to brainstorm new:



* Angles

* Hooks

* Native ad concepts

* Image concepts

* Mechanisms

* Advertorial ideas

* Customer avatars

* Creative iterations

* Competitor breakdowns

* Testing ideas



We want someone who actively brings ideas to the team instead of waiting for tasks.



You should be able to look at performance data and understand what to do next.



If one angle starts working, we expect you to think about:



How can we create 10 new iterations?



What part of the message is actually winning?



Can we attack the same desire from another awareness level?



Can we create a new visual while keeping the same hook?



Can we expand the mechanism?



Can we turn this into another customer avatar?



Can we make the ad feel even more native?



This role is for someone who wants ownership over creative performance.



We are not looking for someone who only “writes copy.”



We are looking for someone who understands markets, customers, psychology, research, creative strategy and Direct Response — and can turn all of that into ads that convert.



When applying, please send:



* Your best Native Ads

* Your best Direct Response copy

* Winning creatives you personally worked on

* Examples that have spent significant amounts of money

* The approximate ad spend behind your strongest creatives, if available

* Supplement / health offers you have worked on

* Examples of your research or creative strategy process

* A short explanation of how you approach Market Sophistication

* Which AI tools you currently use

* Your availability



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the number “70” so I know you read the entire job post.



If your application does not start with 70, it will not be considered.

title: Data Entry & Report Processing Specialist – Real Estate Appraisal |
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established U.S.-based residential real estate appraisal firm in Arkansas. We have been in business since 1992 and operate fully remote. Our team includes appraisers in the US and virtual assistants in the Philippines. We are looking for one person to join us long-term.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a report preparation role. Before one of our appraisers begins their analysis, you will build out and verify the report file so it is complete, accurate, and ready for them to work from. You will follow a written checklist, enter data from source documents, and flag anything that looks inconsistent or missing.



IMPORTANT: This position requires you to work US business hours, which means working overnight in Philippine time. This is not negotiable. We train and answer questions in real time, and that only works if you are online when we are. Please do not apply if you are unable to commit to a night shift schedule long-term.



This is not a sales, cold-calling, appointment-setting, or social media position. You will not be expected to develop property values or make appraisal decisions. Those are our appraisers' responsibility.



You do not need real estate or appraisal experience. Prior experience in real estate, and especially in real estate appraisal, is a strong plus and we would like to hear about it — but it is not required, and we will train you on everything specific to our work. What we cannot train is care, consistency, and the willingness to slow down and check your work.



This is a detail and accuracy role, not a writing or analysis role. If you enjoy checklists, clear procedures, and methodical recurring work, you will do well here. If you get bored with repetitive work and start rushing, this is not the right fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Prepare appraisal reports so they are ready for the appraiser's analysis

- Enter data accurately from source documents into our appraisal software

- Work through a written checklist of roughly 80 checkpoints

- Verify that data matches across multiple sections of the same document

- Correct or flag inconsistencies, missing information, and formatting errors

- Update assignment status in our workflow system

- Save files to the correct folders using our naming conventions

- Communicate daily with our office manager and lead VA



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English. You will read detailed instructions and write short notes.

- Very high attention to detail. This is the single most important requirement.

- Able to work a night shift in Philippine time on an ongoing basis

- Reliable computer, reliable internet, dependable attendance

- Someone who asks questions instead of guessing

- Someone who wants a stable long-term position, not a stepping stone



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with TOTAL by a la mode, or with US MLS systems

- Prior data entry, document processing, quality control, proofreading, or bookkeeping experience

- Any exposure to US real estate, mortgage, or title work



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, [X] hours per week

- Work hours are [X] to [X] US Central Time, Monday through Friday

- This is approximately [X] to [X] Philippine time (overnight shift)

- Paid training period

- Long-term position with annual review



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Attention to detail and following instructions are part of this job, so the application is part of the test.



Send your application with the subject line: CLEANUP-2026



Answer the seven questions below using the same numbers shown. Keep your answers concise — we do not need a long cover letter. Please answer in your own words. Do not use AI to write your answers; we can tell, and those applications will not be considered.



1. Are you currently working for another employer or regular client? If yes, roughly how many hours per week?



2. Are you able to work overnight in Philippine time, Monday through Friday, on an ongoing basis? Have you done night shift work before? If so, for how long?



3. Describe any experience you have with US real estate appraisal work or with TOTAL by a la mode. If you have none, simply write "No appraisal experience."



4. Briefly describe your experience with data entry, document review, quality control, or other work requiring a high level of accuracy.



5. Describe a time you found a mistake or inconsistency that other people had missed. What were you doing, and how did you notice it?



6. You are following a written checklist. Partway through, you notice something that looks wrong, but it is not on the checklist and no one told you what to do about it. What do you do, and why?



7. What monthly salary are you seeking for a full-time position?



Applications without the correct subject line will not be read. Applications that do not answer all questions will not be read.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Applicants who look like a good fit will be invited to complete a short paid skills test — about two hours, paid at the full rate — designed to evaluate accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to follow written instructions. Candidates who do well will then be invited to a short video interview.



We are looking for the right long-term person, not simply the applicant with the most experience.

Saturday & Sunday | £40 per day | Remote



Looking for a reliable, highly organised Virtual Assistant to help manage the day-to-day operations of our London comedy shows every Saturday and Sunday.



We run multiple comedy shows across London each week, so weekends can be fast-moving. We're looking for someone who is extremely attentive to detail, communicates clearly and can stay on top of several things happening at once.



We provide training for our systems and have step-by-step guides for our regular processes. Previous Virtual Assistant or comedy experience isn't required.



What matters most is that you're reliable, organised, quick to respond and able to think independently.



What you'll be doing:



Checking our shows and ticketing platforms.

You'll check that our weekend shows are correctly listed across platforms such as Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, Dice, Fever, etc, including show times, ticket availability, description, pictures, etc.



Monitoring ticket sales.

You'll keep an eye on how shows are selling, make required updates when shows sell out or availability changes, and make sure our internal records are accurate.



Dealing with customer
s.

You'll respond to customer questions about tickets, show times, locations, accessibility, refunds, group bookings and other enquiries using our processes and templates.



Managing comedian changes.

Comedians occasionally drop out at short notice. You'll help contact replacement comedians, update the lineup and make sure the relevant people know about any changes.



Checking show operations.

You'll make sure the correct comedians and showrunners are confirmed for each show and flag anything that could cause a problem before the show starts.



Checking listings and promotions.

You'll make sure our shows are displaying correctly online and help with simple promotional tasks when required.



Monitoring reviews.

You'll check for new reviews, flag anything that needs attention and help make sure customer feedback isn't missed.



Keeping our systems updated.

You'll update ClickUp, Google Sheets and our other tracking systems so that information remains accurate throughout the weekend.



How we work



This role requires someone who can become independent once trained.



We'll provide instructions and answer questions, but once you understand a process, we expect you to take ownership of it rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



For example, if you notice that a show is happening that evening but a comedian hasn't confirmed, we want you to recognise that as something that needs attention and take the appropriate next steps.



If something doesn't look right, check it rather than assuming it's correct.



If something goes wrong — including if you make a mistake — tell us immediately. We'd much rather know straight away so we can fix it.



The most important qualities for this role



Exceptional attention to detail — you notice incorrect dates, times, links, venues and other inconsistencies.

Reliability — weekends are when our shows are happening, so we need someone we can depend on.

Independent thinking — once trained, you can work out what needs attention without constant supervision.

Following instructions precisely — if a process has six steps, you complete all six.

Speed and organisation — you can deal with multiple shows and tasks without things getting forgotten.

Strong written English — you'll communicate with customers, comedians, venues and our team.

Calm problem-solving — last-minute changes happen in live events, and you need to be able to deal with them logically.

Honesty and accountability — if you don't understand something or make a mistake, you tell us immediately.



Pay & Hours



£40 per day / £80 per weekend



Saturday and Sunday



This is a remote role.



You'll need to be available and responsive during your agreed working hours because our shows take place throughout the weekend.



Payment is made weekly.



Requirements



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organisation and time management.

* Able to work independently after training.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

* Comfortable using Google Sheets and learning new online systems.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Available consistently on Saturdays and Sundays.

* Willing to learn ClickUp, Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, Meta Ads Manager and our other systems.



Previous VA experience isn't required. We'd rather hire someone smart, careful, dependable and willing to learn than someone with years of experience who doesn't pay attention.



How to apply



Please send us a short application answering the following:



1. Why do you think this particular role would suit you?

2. Tell us about a time you spotted an error or problem that somebody else had missed. What did you do?

3. Imagine we have four comedy shows happening tonight and one comedian messages two hours before their show saying they can't attend. What would you do?

4. Tell us about your internet connection and what backup you have if your internet or power goes down.

5. Are you consistently available to work Saturdays and Sundays?



Please don't send a generic or obviously copy-pasted Virtual Assistant application. We're much more interested in seeing how you think and communicate.



To show us you've read the full job description, put the word **milkshake** in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be considered.



Spend: 7 Apply Points

title: Fractional Finance Lead (Part-Time · Remote)
description:
Job Opportunity: Fractional Finance Lead (Part-Time · Remote)



Schedule: Part-Time / Fractional · Remote · UK-aligned Commitment: ~5–6 days per month to start (the first working days of each month for month-end close), scaling to ~9 days as the role grows into ongoing financial oversight



Who We Are



We are a fast-growing Short Let / Airbnb Management company managing a portfolio of high-quality properties across the UK. We are systems-driven and process-focused, and as we scale we want our numbers owned properly — and our external revenue-management partners held to account by someone on our side of the table.



Why This Role Exists



This role exists to bring financial ownership in-house. Right now, month-end and financial oversight are stretched. We're starting with a clean, reliable monthly close and reconciliation — and as trust is built and you get to know our numbers, the role grows into wider financial oversight, including holding our external revenue-management partners to account on our behalf.



What You'll Be Doing



From the start:



Own the month-end close cycle end to end

Reconcile bookings, payouts and channel data; keep Guesty financials accurate

Produce clear, correct owner statements and payout reports

Flag risks, discrepancies and errors in plain English



Growing into (once the close is running smoothly and you know our numbers):



Ongoing financial oversight between closes

Reviewing and challenging the external revenue-management team's decisions on our behalf

Surfacing opportunities, not just problems



Who You Are



Qualified or part-qualified accountant (ACCA / CIMA / CA or local equivalent)

Have independently owned a month-end close and reconciliations

Property management / short-term rental finance exposure a strong plus (owner payouts, channel reconciliation, Guesty or similar PMS)

Comfortable working fractionally and self-directing

Capable of growing into a challenge role — you'll question numbers and partners, not just record them



Tools You'll Use



Guesty · Google Sheets & Docs · ClickUp · Freeagent



What You'll Get



Rate: this is a fractional engagement — please state your day rate, or your expected monthly rate for the ~5–6 day starting commitment when you apply

A role that starts focused and grows in scope (and days) as you prove out

A defined, ownership-level engagement with a growing business

Flexibility of a fractional arrangement



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



Your CV

Your qualification and a summary of month-end closes you've owned

A note on any property-management / STR or Guesty finance experience

Your expected monthly (or day) rate for the ~9-day commitment

Answer this in writing: "You're handed a month of bookings and payouts and the numbers don't tie out. Walk me through how you'd find and resolve the gap — and what you'd question."

Two professional references (name, relationship,
, phone number)



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid reconciliation task using sanitised data before any final interview. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

description:

Part-Time Content & Social Media Coordinator



20 Hours/Week | Remote | Philippines



The Lacy Employment Law Firm is looking for a creative, highly organized Content & Social Media Coordinator to help grow and manage our online presence.



This is not a traditional VA role where you wait for assignments. We want someone who can own the content process, bring us ideas, keep our founder accountable, and turn approximately one hour of his time each week into consistent content across multiple platforms.



Our founder already has approximately 13,000 LinkedIn followers and 8,000 TikTok followers, and we want to significantly expand our presence on TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, and
.



Schedule

Approximately 20 hours per week

Must generally be available 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

This is approximately 8:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m. Philippine Time during U.S. daylight saving time



What You’ll Do:



Create and manage a weekly content calendar

Research employment-law topics, workplace trends, FAQs, and timely news

Come to our founder each week with the videos he should record

Prepare hooks, titles, and simple talking points

Schedule and manage a weekly recording session

Hold our founder accountable for recording content

Edit videos or coordinate editing

Turn long-form YouTube videos into TikToks, Reels, Shorts, and LinkedIn content

Post and schedule content across platforms

Help create YouTube thumbnails, captions, titles, and descriptions

Repurpose video into newsletters and written content

Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve research and content production

Monitor analytics and recommend what we should create next

Organize our existing content so strong material can be reused

What We’re Looking For



We want someone who is:



Extremely organized and proactive

Creative and interested in social media

Comfortable managing up and following up with a busy founder

Familiar with TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and LinkedIn

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

A strong English communicator

Able to work independently without constant instructions

Good at identifying interesting hooks and content ideas



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, YouTube, short-form video, newsletters, or social media analytics is a major plus.



You do not need to know U.S. employment law. We can teach you the subject matter.



What Success Looks Like



Your biggest goal is simple:



Our founder spends approximately one hour per week recording content, while you turn that hour into content that appears throughout the entire week.



We do not want someone who constantly asks:



“What should I post?”



We want someone who comes to us and says:



“Here is what we should record this week, and here is why.”



Compensation



Approximately $10–$15 USD/hour depending on experience and ability.



This position is initially approximately 20 hours per week, with room to grow for an exceptional person.



How to Apply



Applications will only be considered if submitted through our Airtable application form:
