title: Creative Content & Digital Asset Manager
description:
Job Description – Creative Content & Digital Asset Manager



Full-Time Remote Position



About Space Art Cabinetry:



Space Art Cabinetry is a growing custom cabinetry company specializing in kitchens, custom closets, and other cabinetry and storage solutions.

Every project we design and complete creates valuable visual material, renderings, drawings, progress photos, finished photography, job-site videos, and more.

We are looking for someone to take ownership of those digital assets and turn them into long-term value for the company.

This is not a traditional Social Media Manager position. It is a hands-on combination of digital asset management, creative content production, AI-powered visual creation, and digital marketing.



Mission of the Role:



You will own the lifecycle of our visual content, from raw material to organized assets to polished content that can be used for marketing, sales, our website, social media, and presentations.

A successful person in this role should constantly be thinking:

“What valuable content do we have, what are we missing, and how can I turn it into something useful?”



Key Responsibilities:



1. Digital Asset & Project Portfolio Management

• Take ownership of the company's growing library of photos, videos, renderings, drawings, graphics, and other visual assets.

• Gather assets coming from multiple sources, including project managers, installers, job sites, internal communication channels, renderings, phones, drone footage, and management.

• Develop and maintain an organized, scalable Digital Asset Management system.

• Recommend the best platforms, workflows, naming structures, folders, tagging systems, and processes for managing our assets.

• Make assets easy to search, retrieve, share, and reuse.

• Review incoming content and identify what is valuable, what needs improvement, and how it can be used.

• Maintain organized portfolios of completed and ongoing projects.

• Ensure valuable content does not get lost simply because nobody noticed or organized it.

2. Photo, Rendering & Visual Production

• Select and prepare the best images from projects.

• Retouch, crop, color-correct, clean up, enhance, and professionally present photographs.

• Improve job-site photos that were taken under less-than-ideal conditions.

• Work with architectural/design renderings and transform them into more realistic, polished marketing visuals when appropriate.

• Create new visuals using existing drawings, layouts, renderings, photos, and AI tools.

• Create before/after, progress, comparison, project showcase, and similar visual content.

• Handle day-to-day digital graphic design needs without requiring an outside graphic designer for every small task.

3. Video Content

We do not expect high-end film production. We do expect strong, practical digital video skills.

Responsibilities include:

• Gather raw video from job sites, phones, project managers, installers, and future drone footage.

• Identify the best clips and turn raw footage into useful content.

• Trim, combine, clean up, resize, and enhance video.

• Add captions, text, graphics, transitions, music, voiceovers, or other elements when appropriate.

• Remove or replace unwanted audio.

• Combine photos, renderings, progress footage, and finished footage into project videos.

• Produce reels, progress updates, before/after videos, finished-project showcases, and other short-form content.

• Repurpose one set of footage into multiple pieces of content when possible.

4. Directing Content Capture

You will not personally be present at every project. Therefore, part of your responsibility is helping our field team capture better raw material.

• Create simple shot lists and instructions for project managers and installers.

• Proactively request specific photos, videos, angles, progress shots, or drone footage.

• Identify missing content before the opportunity is gone.

• Educate team members on what makes footage useful for marketing.

• Think ahead about what will be needed to properly showcase a project after completion.

5. Social Media & Digital Presence

Own the day-to-day execution of our digital presence, particularly:

• Instagram

• LinkedIn

• WhatsApp Status

• Google Business presence

• Company website

• 

• Other relevant platforms as they develop

Responsibilities include:

• Develop content from our existing project assets.

• Write or refine captions and supporting copy.

• Create and publish posts, reels, project showcases, and updates.

• Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

• Actively optimize content for maximum reach, traffic, engagement, and exposure on each platform. Understand how each platform’s algorithms, formats, timing, keywords, hashtags, trends, and other best practices affect visibility, and continuously test and improve our approach based on performance.

• Adapt content appropriately for different platforms rather than simply posting the exact same thing everywhere.

• Monitor and respond appropriately to comments, messages, and DMs.

• Keep the company's online presence active, polished, professional, and consistent with our established brand guidelines.

• Look for opportunities to repurpose existing material rather than constantly needing new content.

6. Website & Project Portfolio

• Keep the website visually current and up to date.

• Maintain the website’s project portfolio and visual content on an ongoing basis, ensuring it remains current, polished, accurate, and reflective of the company’s latest work.

• Upload completed projects with strong imagery and well-written descriptions.

• Organize projects so prospective customers can easily understand the work being presented.

• Maintain and improve the online portfolio as new work becomes available.

• Handle basic website content updates and minor technical/HTML-related work when needed.

• Coordinate with outside technical professionals when an update is beyond the scope of this position.

7.
 & Other Digital Marketing

When
 marketing campaigns are used:

• Prepare and organize the visual content.

• Build or assist with
 layouts.

• Insert images, links, buttons, and other digital assets correctly.

• Handle basic formatting/HTML as necessary.

• Coordinate with others when copywriting or more advanced technical work is required.

8. AI & Technology

Advanced practical use of AI is an important part of this position.

We want someone who actively explores how modern tools can make work faster, better, and possible.

This may include AI for:

• Image generation and enhancement

• Rendering enhancement and photorealistic visualization

• Photo editing and cleanup

• Video production and editing

• Voiceover/audio

• Graphic creation

• Content development

• Copy assistance

• Workflow automation

• Asset organization

• Research and productivity

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to type prompts into ChatGPT. We want someone who is curious about new technology, experiments with tools, learns quickly, and continually improves the workflow.



Required Experience & Skills:



We are primarily interested in ability and portfolio, not degrees or job titles.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Approximately 2–5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in digital content, multimedia, creative production, digital marketing, or a related field.

• Strong creative judgment, the ability to independently recognize what looks professional, what content has marketing potential, and what needs improvement without requiring detailed direction for every task.

• Strong photo editing and enhancement abilities.

• Practical video editing experience.

• Good graphic design skills and a strong visual eye.

• Experience creating content specifically for social media.

• Understanding of social media platforms, formats, trends, and engagement.

• Experience working with AI-powered creative tools.

• Strong organizational and digital file-management skills.

• Ability to learn new platforms and software quickly.

• Basic website/content-management experience.

• Basic HTML knowledge is preferred.

• Excellent written English.

• Clear spoken English for internal meetings and communication.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership.



Cultural & Brand Adaptability:



Our company serves customers with specific preferences, expectations, communication styles, and cultural nuances.

The successful candidate must be able to:

• Observe and quickly understand the culture and audience of the company.

• Learn subtle differences in communication, imagery, style, and presentation.

• Avoid assuming that what works for one audience automatically works for another.

• Follow established brand guidelines while developing a strong understanding of what feels appropriate for our customers.

• Accept feedback and quickly adapt.



Who Will Thrive in This Position:



You will likely do very well here if you are the type of person who:

• Sees an interesting job-site photo and immediately thinks, “We can do something with this.”

• Doesn't wait to be told every individual task.

• Enjoys both creativity and organization.

• Likes turning messy raw material into something polished.

• Notices missing information and goes after it.

• Enjoys experimenting with AI and new technology.

• Can research a problem and propose a solution.

• Can build a system instead of simply following one.

• Understands that creating great content and properly organizing it are equally important.

• Takes ownership and follows things through to completion.



Work Schedule:



This is a full-time remote position working on our standard Eastern Time schedule:

Monday–Thursday: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time

Friday: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

Candidates must be consistently available for communication, collaboration, and meetings during these hours.



Equipment & Work Environment:



Because this is a remote creative position, the selected candidate must have:

• A modern, reliable computer powerful enough to smoothly handle professional photo editing, video editing, graphics, browser-based AI tools, and multitasking.

• 32 GB RAM minimum; 64 GB preferred.

• Modern Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 / Apple Silicon equivalent or better preferred.

• Dedicated modern GPU with at least 8 GB of VRAM preferred, suitable for professional video editing, rendering, and AI workloads.

• 1 TB SSD storage.

• Reliable high-speed internet suitable for regularly uploading and downloading large photo and video files.

• Webcam and good-quality headset/microphone.

• A quiet, professional, designated workspace.

• A second monitor is strongly preferred.

The selected candidate is expected to provide and maintain the standard hardware, software, tools, and resources commonly required to perform this type of professional creative work.

Specialized, enterprise-level, unusually expensive, or company-specific tools may be provided by Space Art Cabinetry at the company's discretion.



Portfolio Required:



Applicants must submit examples of previous work.

We are particularly interested in seeing examples involving:

• Photo editing/enhancement

• Social media content

• Graphics

• Video editing

• Project or portfolio presentation

• AI-generated or AI-enhanced creative work

Please clearly explain what you personally did on each example.



Hiring Process:



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will go through:

1. Initial application and portfolio review.

2. Video interview.

3. Practical skills test using sample materials similar to what you would receive in this position.

4. Final interview.

5. Paid introductory/trial period.

The practical test may include raw project photos, videos, renderings, and other assets. Candidates may be asked to demonstrate how they would organize the assets, improve them, turn them into useful content, and d
 how that content should be presented or distributed.



Compensation:



Hourly position.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, portfolio quality, technical ability, and performance during the practical skills evaluation.

Performance and compensation may be reviewed after the initial employment period.

________________________________________

The bottom line: We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our company's digital assets and digital presence, from a raw photo sitting in a job-site chat to a polished image, project portfolio, website update, reel, or social media post.

If you are highly organized, visually creative, technically capable, AI-driven, and naturally look for ways to turn raw material into valuable content, we would like to hear from you.

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Full-Time (40+ hours per week, depending on business needs)

Working Hours: U.S. Central Time (CST)



Job Description



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities



Open Items Follow Up

Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.



Client Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.



Document Review and Organization

Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

Upload, categorize, and organize files in the appropriate client folder or system.

Update open-item lists immediately when documents or responses are received.

Confirm that resolved items are properly closed before work is returned to the tax or accounting team.



Internal Coordination

Communicate with tax preparers, reviewers, bookkeepers, and other team members regarding unresolved items.

Ask internal team members for clarification when a request is unclear or appears duplicative.

Provide clear status updates on clients with outstanding items.

Notify the appropriate team member when all requested information has been received.

Escalate technical tax or accounting questions rather than attempting to answer them independently.



Deadline Management

Monitor due dates associated with open requests.

Prioritize follow-ups based on filing deadlines, internal deadlines, and engagement urgency.

Follow up before outstanding items become urgent.

Maintain accurate tracking so the team has visibility into delayed or unresponsive clients.

Ensure no engagement is delayed without documented follow-up and escalation.



Role Expectations

Open-item requests are accurate and do not duplicate information already provided.

Clients receive timely, clear, and professional follow-up.

Outstanding items are followed through to completion rather than simply requested once.

Client responses and documents are accurately tracked and organized.

Unresponsive clients are escalated early.

The tax and accounting teams can quickly see what is missing and what has been received.

No engagement falls behind because an open item was forgotten or not followed up on.



Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Tax, Bookkeeping, Finance, or a related field

Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

Strong understanding of the U.S. tax return preparation process for both individual and business tax engagements

Familiarity with the following U.S. tax forms is strongly preferred:



Individual Tax Forms

Form 1040 – U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

Schedule A – Itemized Deductions

Schedule B – Interest and Ordinary Dividends

Schedule C – Profit or Loss from Business

Schedule D – Capital Gains and Losses

Schedule E – Supplemental Income and Loss

Form 4562 – Depreciation and Amortization

Form 4797 – Sales of Business Property

Form 8582 – Passive Activity Loss Limitations

Form 8829 – Business Use of Home

Form 8949 – Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

Form 8995 / Form 8995-A – Qualified Business Income (QBI) Deduction



Business Tax Forms

Form 1120 – U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

Form 1120-S – U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation

Form 1065 – U.S. Return of Partnership Income

Form 1041 – U.S. Income Tax Return for Estates and Trusts

Form 941 – Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return

Form 940 – Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return

Forms W-2 and W-3

Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and 1099-INT

Form 1096 – Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns



Ability to identify missing tax documents and proactively follow up on open items with clients and internal team members until resolved

Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and clearly with clients

Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills

High attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality

Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Comfortable using cloud-based tax software, document management systems, and project management tools

Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team

Available to work full-time during U.S. business hours (9:00 AM CST – 6:00 PM CST)



Our Core Values

1. Bring Fun Tax Energy

We're genuinely obsessed with tax — the rules, the strategy, the wins for clients — and that obsession is contagious. We show up with real energy, take pride in the work, and make the experience good for each other and for the client. A great attitude isn't soft; it makes the work better and the people around us better.



2. Speed Drives Results

We love to win, and winning means getting it done. Immediately. We learn fast, adapt fast, and move — because knowing the answer isn't the job, acting on it is. Momentum compounds: the faster we turn knowledge into action, the better the outcome for the client and the firm.



3. Own the Outcome

The result is yours, full stop. We don't love excuses, even if they are real — we love getting results. We don't hand off problems, we solve them. We follow through on what we said we'd do, and when something's in the way, we do what it takes to get it done. No "not my job."



All applications require a 1–2 minute video introduction, along with your resume attached. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Technical Backend & Affiliate Systems Specialist – Peak Media World
description:
**Remote | Part-time / Project-based initially | $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated skills**



About the role



Peak Media World is building a long-term digital knowledge and e-commerce platform with digital products, content, multiple sales channels and a future Partner/Affiliate Network.



We are looking for a technically strong **Backend & Affiliate Systems Specialist** who can help us build the more advanced backend and custom-development components of the system.



You will **not** be responsible for building the entire website alone.



The website foundation, CRM, automation, workflows and platform integrations are being handled internally. Your role is to focus on the areas that require deeper backend development, custom logic and specialist technical expertise.



You will work closely with the person responsible for our systems, automation and integrations so that your development connects cleanly with the overall PMW architecture.



What we are building



The long-term PMW system needs to connect:



* the website

* digital products and e-commerce

* Gumroad and potentially other sales channels

* customer data and CRM

* payment systems

* automation and workflows

* content channels

* partner/referral tracking

* commissions

* partner accounts and dashboards

* future automated processes



Our goal is to build the foundation correctly from the beginning so that the system can grow without requiring a complete rebuild later.



Your main area of responsibility



You would focus particularly on the more advanced Partner/Affiliate and backend requirements, including:



* backend architecture and custom development

* database design and data structures

* API development and integration

* affiliate/referral tracking

* partner IDs and referral links

* source and conversion tracking

* custom attribution logic

* commission calculation systems

* transaction and commission history

* refund and cancellation handling

* authentication and permissions

* secure access to customer and partner data

* security and fraud prevention

* scalable backend architecture

* future automated payout functionality



Partner / Affiliate system



The Partner Network is not intended to be a simple “last click wins” affiliate system.



The planned system includes:



* individual Partner IDs

* product-specific partner links

* referral and source tracking

* customer/partner attribution

* a 90-day attribution period

* potentially multiple active partner attributions for the same customer

* commission calculation based on the actual amount paid by the customer

* refund and cancellation handling

* partner performance information

* restricted partner access

* future partner dashboards

* future automated payouts



The standard commission for qualifying digital products is currently planned at 30%, with individually negotiated exceptions possible.



The system therefore needs to be flexible enough to support more complex commission and attribution rules in the future.



Security and fraud prevention



Because the system will involve customer data, partner information and financial commissions, we need someone who understands:



* authentication

* authorization and permissions

* secure API communication

* data protection

* fraud prevention

* self-referral prevention

* artificial or suspicious sales

* audit trails and transaction history

* secure handling of sensitive information



Integrations



The system will need to communicate with external platforms and services.



Experience with technologies such as:



* REST APIs

* webhooks

* authentication

* database systems

* payment APIs

* automation platforms

* SaaS integrations



is highly desirable.



Experience with platforms such as GoHighLevel, n8n, Gumroad, Stripe or similar systems is a plus, but **strong technical understanding is more important than experience with one specific platform**.



What we are looking for



You should have demonstrated experience with several of the following:



* Backend development

* Database architecture

* API development

* Affiliate/referral systems

* Attribution systems

* Commission systems

* Payment or payout systems

* Authentication and permissions

* Security

* Fraud prevention

* SaaS integrations

* Scalable system architecture



We are particularly interested in people who can **think about the architecture before writing the code** and who understand how different systems and data flows need to work together.



Important



This is not primarily a website-design position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving **complex technical problems and building reliable backend systems**.



We also do not expect you to build everything alone. You will work as part of a small team with clearly separated responsibilities.



The initial engagement may be part-time or project-based and can grow over time as Peak Media World develops.



To apply



Please tell us:



1. What relevant backend or systems you have built.

2. Whether you have experience with affiliate/referral systems.

3. Whether you have worked with attribution or commission logic.

4. Which databases, programming languages and backend technologies you use.

5. Which APIs and payment systems you have integrated.

6. Whether you have experience with security or fraud prevention.

7. Please provide examples, portfolio links, GitHub or other relevant work where possible.

8. Your expected hourly rate.

9. Your current availability and how many hours per week you could initially provide.



**Please include the word `ARCHITECT` somewhere in your application so we know you have read the complete job description.**

title: Virtual Assistant – Administrative, Content & E-commerce Support
description:
**Remote | Part-time | Initially 10–20 hours/week | $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience**



**Expected start: around September 1, 2026**



About Peak Media World



Peak Media World is building a growing digital knowledge and e-commerce business with digital products, content, publishing, social media and multiple online sales channels.



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **Virtual Assistant** who can support our growing operations and gradually take over recurring administrative, content and organizational tasks.



This is a part-time position with flexible hours and the possibility of additional work as the business grows.



What you will do



Your tasks will mainly consist of operational and administrative support, including:



* organizing digital files and documents

* maintaining folders and project documentation

* entering and updating information in spreadsheets and online systems

* preparing product information and files for upload

* assisting with digital product uploads and publishing workflows

* supporting Gumroad product uploads and related preparation

* organizing Pinterest and other content assets

* supporting the preparation and organization of content for publication

* entering and formatting content in the relevant systems according to established workflows

* preparing titles, descriptions, keywords and other content information according to provided instructions

* organizing images and other media belonging to individual content pieces

* preparing social media and Pinterest content for publication

* maintaining content calendars, production lists and publication trackers

* checking documents and content for completeness and obvious errors

* conducting simple online research

* collecting and organizing information

* following established workflows and instructions

* keeping internal lists and trackers up to date

* helping prepare materials for future content production

* supporting the team with additional administrative and operational tasks as needed



As Peak Media World grows, your responsibilities may gradually expand.



Content support



Content is an important part of Peak Media World.



You will **not** be expected to develop the overall content strategy or make major editorial decisions.



Instead, you will help turn already prepared and approved content into organized, publication-ready material.



This may include:



* preparing content according to templates

* transferring approved content into the appropriate platforms

* organizing text, images and supporting files

* preparing posts and publication materials

* maintaining content schedules

* checking that all required elements are present

* publishing or preparing content for publication according to established instructions



The goal is to make the content production and publishing process as efficient and organized as possible.



What we are looking for



We are looking for someone who is:



* reliable and responsible

* highly organized

* detail-oriented

* comfortable working independently

* willing to learn new online tools and systems

* able to follow structured processes accurately

* good at recognizing when something does not look right

* comfortable asking questions when clarification is needed

* proactive without constantly needing supervision

* professional and friendly in communication

* comfortable working with English-language tools and instructions



Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, E-commerce Assistant, Content Assistant or similar role is helpful.



Experience with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, Canva, Gumroad, Pinterest, content management systems or other online business tools is a plus, but is not essential if you are a fast learner.



Important



This is primarily an **operational support role**.



You will not be expected to make major strategic, technical or editorial decisions.



Instead, you will help make sure that the many small but important tasks around our content, products, documents and systems are completed accurately and reliably.



We will provide clear instructions and workflows, especially for recurring tasks.



We value someone who can gradually learn our systems and then handle recurring tasks independently.



Working hours



Initially, we expect approximately **10–20 hours per week**.



The schedule can be flexible, but reliability and agreed availability are important.



The position is intended to start on a part-time basis and may grow as Peak Media World develops.



Compensation



**$4–6 USD per hour**, depending on experience, skills and demonstrated ability.



Please state your expected hourly rate in your application.



How to apply



Please tell us:



1. A little about yourself and your previous experience.

2. What kind of Virtual Assistant, administrative, e-commerce or content-related work you have done.

3. Which online tools and platforms you are comfortable using.

4. Whether you have experience with e-commerce, digital products or content management.

5. Whether you have experience preparing or publishing content for social media, Pinterest, websites or other digital platforms.

6. Your English level.

7. Your available hours per week.

8. Your current time zone.

9. Your expected hourly rate.

10. Please provide examples of relevant previous work if available.



**Please include the word `SUPPORT` somewhere in your application so we know that you have read the complete job description.**

title: Corporate Paralegal / Legal Operations Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Corporate Paralegal / Legal Operations Specialist to provide remote legal operations support to our growing business law firm. The initial scope of work will focus on business entity formations, annual reports and other corporate filings, while also assisting with a variety of legal operations and administrative projects.



The engagement is expected to begin at approximately 5 to 10 hours per week. As our firm's needs evolve and additional projects become available, there may be opportunities to take on additional work. Applicants should be available for regular overlap with Pacific Time business hours for training, meetings, and collaboration with our team.

About Bend Law Group, PC



Bend Law Group is a boutique law firm that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses build, protect, and grow what they have created. From forming companies and raising capital to negotiating contracts and protecting intellectual property, we combine big-firm skill with small-firm humanity.



Our team is collaborative, responsive, and fully remote. We are built for people who want meaningful work, professional growth, and the flexibility of working remotely.



We believe exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. If you're looking for meaningful work, enjoy improving systems and processes, and want the flexibility of working remotely with a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy Corporate Paralegal / Legal Operations Specialist to help support the day-to-day legal operations of our growing business law firm.



Initially, you will work closely with members of our operations and legal support team, who will provide hands-on training in the firm's systems, procedures, and workflows. Your initial responsibilities will focus primarily on preparing and submitting government filings related to the formation and ongoing maintenance of corporations, limited liability companies, and other business entities.



You will learn how we prepare and manage filings, gather information from clients and attorneys, maintain accurate corporate records, track compliance deadlines, and communicate with clients, registered agents, and government agencies. As you gain experience, you will be expected to take increasing ownership of these matters and manage recurring filing and compliance responsibilities accurately and efficiently.



As you become proficient with our systems and procedures, there will be opportunities to take on additional legal operations, administrative, and client-service responsibilities. Depending on the firm's needs and your skills and interests, this may include helping improve workflows, documenting procedures, implementing technology, and supporting other projects that make our team more efficient and our clients' experience better.



We value team members who take ownership of their work, communicate proactively, and consistently produce accurate, high-quality results. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning new technology, improving systems and processes, solving problems, and providing exceptional client service.



Key Responsibilities



• Prepare and submit government filings related to the formation and maintenance of corporations, limited liability companies, and other business entities. 



• Prepare and file articles of incorporation, articles of organization, annual reports, California Statements of Information, foreign qualifications, amendments, dissolutions, and other entity maintenance filings. 



• Review filing requirements and verify that all submissions are complete, accurate, and timely. 



• Identify opportunities to improve the firm's systems, workflows, templates, and internal processes.



• Gather information and supporting documentation from attorneys, staff members, clients, government agencies, and online resources. 



• Track filing deadlines, renewal dates, annual reports, and other corporate compliance requirements using the firm's calendaring and workflow systems. 



• Obtain business licenses and other government registrations as needed. 



• Maintain organized electronic corporate records, minute books, and other legal documentation. 



• Monitor the status of pending filings and communicate with government agencies, registered agents, clients, and attorneys regarding entity maintenance matters. 



• Enter and update information in the firm's practice management, document management, and workflow systems, including Microsoft 365, Clio, and other cloud-based legal technology platforms. 



• Assist with special projects and additional legal operations or administrative responsibilities as the firm's needs evolve.



• Maintain and improve written procedures, checklists, and training materials for recurring legal operations, helping ensure that the firm's institutional knowledge is documented and easily transferable across the team.



You Will Thrive Here If You Are



• Detail-Oriented and Reliable: You carefully review your work, follow instructions, and take ownership of deadlines.



• Highly Organized: You can manage multiple tasks and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



• Tech-Savvy: You learn new technology quickly and are comfortable working in cloud-based systems.



• A Strong Communicator: You have professional English verbal and written communication skills.



• Proactive: You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and ask thoughtful questions.



• Team-Oriented: You enjoy collaborating with others and contributing to a supportive work environment.



• Self-Sufficient: You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment and know when to request guidance.



• Service-Minded: You have a genuine passion for helping clients and colleagues.



• Positive and Resourceful: You bring a can-do attitude and look for solutions rather than dwelling on problems.



• Adaptable: You are willing to take on new responsibilities as the position and firm continue to grow.

Qualifications



• Prior experience working in a law firm environment is strongly preferred.



• Experience assisting with corporate, business, or government filings is preferred but not required.



• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.



• Strong organizational and time-management skills.



• Careful attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.



• Ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities.



• Ability to follow written procedures and document recurring processes.



• Comfort learning and using cloud-based legal, communication, and productivity systems.



• Ability to work effectively and communicate consistently in a fully remote environment.



• Experience supporting attorneys, executives, or professional-services firms is a plus.



• Candidates located in Latin America and South America are encouraged to apply.



• Availability for regular working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time Zone.



• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.



• Experience with Clio and Microsoft 365 is preferred.



• Demonstrated ability to learn new software and technology quickly.



Schedule and Engagement



• Independent contractor position.



• Approximately five to 10 hours per week initially.



• Hours may increase as the candidate demonstrates proficiency and assumes additional responsibilities.



• Potential to transition into a substantially expanded or full-time role.



• Fully remote.



• Regular availability during Pacific Time business hours will be required.

Compensation and Benefits



• We anticipate paying $5 to $8 USD per hour, depending on experience.



• Flexible remote-work arrangement.



• Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities.



• Long-term collaboration with a supportive, values-driven team.



• Meaningful work helping entrepreneurs and small businesses.



• A culture built on kindness, clarity, teamwork, and zero tolerance for “law firm jerkiness.”



How to Apply



Please
 the following to 



• Resume (PDF) 

• A video introduction (maximum two minutes) 

• Your current location 

• Your desired hourly rate 

• Your general availability and the number of hours you are currently seeking 



Video Introduction



In your video, please tell us:



• about your professional background and why you're interested in this role; 

• which Bend Law Group value resonates with you most after reviewing our About Us page, and why; 

• about a technology, AI tool, or software platform you learned quickly and how it improved your work; and 

• what you believe would make you a valuable addition to our team.



Please use the subject line:



Responding to Job Advertisement – Corporate Paralegal / Legal Operations Specialist

Typography

Page hierarchy

Long-term remote position

 on the 5th and 20th of each month.

Begin your application with the words:



“I am the individual designer who will do the work.”

You are the flexible builder: you drop into whichever department has the highest-leverage system to ship next, architect it end to end, deploy it to run on its own, and document it so the team can maintain and scale it.



This is not a task-queue job. You are hired as a builder and an innovator. When there is no active request, your job is to find the next process worth automating and prototype it.



Please apply here and send portfolios and resumes to: 



What You Will Do:

-Architect and deploy automation using Claude (API + Skills), n8n, and custom code

-Integrate APIs and OAuth flows across the stack: GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, WordPress, QuickBooks/NetSuite, Microsoft 365, and others

-n8n in production — webhooks, API nodes, branching/conditionals, error handling and retries, OAuth. Tutorial-only experience will not pass screening.

APIs and auth — REST, JSON, API keys/tokens, OAuth flows

, Zapier

What You Get:

-A long-term, full-time role on a funded, growing AI team — not a one-off gig

-Real ownership: you will become the track owner for whole departments



Paid twice a month, on time, via your preferred method

title: WordPress Website Manager & AI Architect
description:
We are seeking a versatile WordPress Website Manager & AI Architect to take full ownership of our WordPress website operations, routine site maintenance, and technical implementations.



The primary focus of this role is website management. You will serve as the technical backbone for our web presence—ensuring our site runs smoothly, implementing landing page designs, and resolving technical integration issues.



In addition to core WordPress administration, you will act as an AI Architect. Rather than relying on traditional, slow-moving developer agencies, you will leverage modern AI models (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to rapidly troubleshoot code, convert export files into functional site layouts, and engineer creative solutions independently.





Primary Responsibilities

1. WordPress Website Management & Maintenance (Priority #1)

Maintain overall health, performance, and security of our WordPress website.

Perform routine site updates, plugin audits, content edits, and technical troubleshooting.

Ensure proper media asset management by uploading graphics to the WordPress Media Library and maintaining clean pathing across all pages.

Audit site builds to maintain fast loading times, clean DOM structures, and strong SEO best practices (avoiding detrimental practices such as site iframing).

2. Design Export & Technical Page Implementation

Resolve export/import challenges between AI design tools (e.g., Claude Design HTML/ZIP exports) and WordPress.

Fix broken image pathing by extracting assets, re-hosting them in the WordPress Media Library, and updating relative URLs.

Request or configure standalone HTML exports with inlined assets/SVGs when rapid execution is required.

Embed clean code into WordPress using Custom HTML blocks or code-snippet plugins without breaking existing site styles.

3. Native Layout Rebuilding in Page Builders

Rebuild exported AI designs natively using popular WordPress page builders (Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi).

Use AI-generated designs as visual blueprints to precisely match colors, typography, spacing, and structural alignment natively.

Ensure all pages built in page builders are fully responsive, easy to edit for non-technical team members, and optimized to rank in search engines.

4. AI-Powered Problem Solving ("AI Architect" Duties)

Act as an AI Architect by continuously prompting and collaborating with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to diagnose technical bugs and generate solutions.

Bridge technical gaps independently by taking high-level guidelines, working through AI iterations, and presenting finished solutions.

Participate in practical live troubleshooting calls or screening tasks to demonstrate live problem-solving workflows.

Role Breakdown

Core Domain

Key Task Focus

Estimated Allocation

Website Management

WordPress maintenance, plugin updates, media library organizing, SEO formatting

50%

Page Building & Layouts

Rebuilding designs natively in Gutenberg / Elementor / Divi

25%

AI Technical Architecture

Troubleshooting export issues, writing code snippets, prompting AI for fixes

25%



Required Technical Skills

WordPress Expertise

CMS Management: Strong background in WordPress core, media asset management, and hosting environments.

Page Builders: Direct experience building and editing layouts in Gutenberg, Elementor, or Divi.

HTML/CSS & Asset Pathing: Understanding of HTML file structures, relative vs. absolute file paths, and CSS alignment.

AI-Assisted Problem Solving (AI Architect)

Prompt Engineering for Development: Ability to feed error logs, HTML/CSS exports, and design guidelines into AI models to output working code or step-by-step resolution paths.

Resourceful Troubleshooting: Willingness to iterate with AI to solve novel challenges (e.g., fixing Claude Design export quirks, path rewrites, or builder compatibility).

AI Tool Fluency: Familiarity with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) and automation tools (e.g., Apify or web scraping utilities) to streamline research and hiring/management tasks.

Qualifications

Portfolio / Track Record: Proven experience building or maintaining pages using native page builders (Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg).

Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive mindset that defaults to testing, learning, and leveraging AI tools rather than waiting on third-party agencies.

Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable recording Loom video walkthroughs or providing clear technical documentation.

title: Inside Sales Associate (Outbound Caller)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for highly driven and motivated Inside Sales Associate/ Outbound Caller to join our growing team in the business financing industry.



This role is focused on outbound lead generation, qualification, and appointment setting. You will be the first point of contact for potential business clients—guiding them through the application process and connecting qualified prospects with our closing team.



This is a fast-paced, performance-driven opportunity ideal for individuals who are coachable, competitive, confident on the phone, and motivated by high earning potential.



Trial & Recruitment Process (Required for All Applicants)



All candidates are required to complete a 4-day trial process as part of the recruitment and evaluation process. Performance during the trial will determine:

- Your qualification for the role

- Your final job offer

- Your starting hourly rate within our compensation range



Trial Schedule

Day 1:

Training on systems, scripts, objection handling, and live roleplay sessions



Days 2–4:

Live outbound calling using the company dialer



Trial Requirement

To successfully pass the trial, candidates must:

- Secure at least 1 qualified appointment during the live calling days

- A “qualified appointment” is not simply an interested lead

- The lead must be reviewed and approved by management/closers as a legitimate qualified transfer



Trial Outcome

If successful:

- Receive a $50 USD trial payout

- Receive an immediate ISA job offer

- Compensation package will be based on trial performance



If unsuccessful:

- The recruitment process will conclude with no further obligation from either party and $50 will not be paid



Work Schedule

Monday to Thursday only (4-day work week)

8 hours per day

Must be available during U.S. business hours

(10:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT)



Enjoy a 3-day weekend while maintaining strong earning potential.



Key Responsibilities

- Make 250+ outbound calls daily to potential business clients

- Guide prospects through the credit application process

- Collect and organize required documentation: Signed credit application, 6 months of bank statements, Voided check, Valid government-issued ID

- Upload completed files into the company system

- Ensure submissions meet “full package” underwriting requirements

- Transfer qualified clients to a live closer

- Maintain consistent pipeline activity and performance metrics



Compensation Structure (Post-Trial)

- Hourly Rate

- $5–$7 USD/hour (Final rate determined based on trial performance and overall evaluation)

- Commission Structure

$20 per qualified appointment

$50 per closed deal

$50 recurring bonus for repeat deals from your clients



High performers are rewarded based on consistency and results.



We’re Looking For Someone Who Is:

- Fluent in English with clear and neutral communication

- Comfortable working U.S. business hours

- Financially motivated and goal-oriented

- Energetic, confident, and persuasive on calls

- Able to handle high daily call volume

- Sales experience is a plus (training provided)



Why Join Us?

- High earning potential with performance-based rewards

- Fully remote setup

- 4-day work week with 3 days off

- Access to premium sales training

- Clear growth opportunities into senior SDR or closer roles

- Performance-focused environment with uncapped upside



Applicants are required to submit their resume via a shareable link with access granted for review.

title: Inside Sales Representative – Business Funding
description:
About the Role

Are you an experienced, high-energy cold caller who knows how to close business owners on the phone? We are a fast-growing financial firm offering Merchant Cash Advances (MCA), Lines of Credit, and Commercial Mortgages to business owners across the United States.



We are looking for elite Outbound Sales Representatives with fluent, accent-neutral English to generate leads and pre-qualify business owners looking for working capital.



If you have a strong sales drive, want to earn $1,000+ per month, and love the idea of a 3-day weekend every single week, this is the position for you!



Key Benefits

3-Day Weekend Every Week: Work hard Monday through Thursday, then enjoy Friday, Saturday, and Sunday off.



High Earning Potential: Strong performers can easily reach $1,000+ per month combining guaranteed hourly pay with instant payouts on apps and funded deals.



Clear Career Growth: We promote strictly from within. Top performers quickly advance to Senior Broker, Account Executive, or Leadership roles with higher pay.



Support & Systems: We provide dialers, scripts, and high-converting lead lists—you bring the hustle.



What You’ll Do

Conduct high-volume outbound cold calls to US small business owners during US business hours.



Pitch our suite of financial products (MCA, Lines of Credit, Mortgages).



Uncover funding needs and pre-qualify interested business owners.



Collect merchant applications ($20 payout per valid app).



Hand off warm, qualified deals to our closing team ($50 bonus per deal funded).



Requirements

Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven experience in outbound sales, cold calling, or B2B phone sales (experience in MCA, business loans, or mortgages is highly preferred).



Language Skills: Perfect, fluent English (native or near-native level) with excellent tone, confidence, and conversational skills.



US Schedule: Must be able to work full US business hours (EST/PST) Monday through Thursday.



Sales Mindset: High energy, resilient, and motivated to hit and exceed monthly financial targets.



Tech Requirements: Dedicated, quiet home office, high-speed internet (20+ Mbps), and a noise-canceling USB headset.

title: UI/UX Designer (Web & Dashboards) | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
I run a fast-growing AI consulting business serving high-profile entrepreneurs in the German-speaking market. We help them work with Claude and we build the systems that run their business, and right now design is our bottleneck. Three client sites are sitting on hold because there is nobody to design them, our dashboards, the ones clients actually log into, still look thrown together, and my own websites and forms are nowhere near the level I want them at.



I'm hiring one designer who owns how our work looks and feels, end to end. You design in Pencil (our AI-native design tool, same core concepts as Figma). At the start, a developer on my team turns your design into a working page using Claude, so you can focus entirely on the design itself. But this role is built to grow: if you're someone who loves picking up new skills, within your first weeks here you'll also learn to use Claude yourself to turn what you draw into a live, deployed page. That's the direction this role is headed, and it's a real skill upgrade for your own future.





Who you'll work with



You work directly with me and with a small, tight team of developers, an executive assistant and a copywriter, all full-time, all on OnlineJobs.ph like you. We have a short daily check-in and a written end-of-day report from everyone. You and the copywriter work from the same brief, in parallel, so a piece of content and its visuals come together instead of one waiting on the other. Clear structures, fast decisions, no corporate politics.





What you will do



- Design the client sites currently on hold, and future ones, in Pencil

- Design our dashboards and our cockpit, internal and client-facing: panels, tables, charts, numbers a busy person has to read in seconds

- Design my own landing pages, forms and website: modern, interactive, a cut above what people expect

- Create the visuals for our content, made yourself or generated

- Apply our design systems consistently across everything, so our work looks like one company





Where this grows



Beyond that, I want you to eventually own our whole creative department: every visual, every deployed page, idea to finished live page, one person, one pair of hands. You don't need any of that on day one, but I want someone who is excited to grow into it fast, not someone who wants to stay a pure designer forever.





Growth



You're joining a forward-thinking AI consulting business at a point where everything is moving fast. The skills you build here, working daily with Claude and modern AI tools, are exactly the skills that matter most for the next years, whatever career you build after this. This is a real personal and professional growth curve.





The basics



- Hours: Gulf Standard Time, 10 AM to 6 PM Dubai (2 to 10 PM Philippines), same as the whole team

- Pay: $800 USD/month to start, performance culture, raises come fast for strong work

- Full-time, long-term





What matters most to me



One thing above everything: judgment of your own. Give you our current site, two or three examples I like, our positioning and colors, and you come back with something better than what I could have described.



And as with everyone on my team: honesty and reliability. When you tell me something is done, I need to fully trust that. "Done" has to mean done, checked on desktop and on a phone.





Must-have



- Strong portfolio with real design thinking: visual hierarchy resolved, a system behind it, not one-off pieces that all look different (proof required)

- Comfortable turning a loose, open brief into a finished concept without waiting for a reference or a draft

- Interface design for data: panels, tables, charts, dashboards

- Fluent in Figma or an equivalent modern design tool (we work in Pencil, same core concepts, a few days to switch)

- Comfortable working with AI tools to iterate and communicate your design intent, even if you don't write code yourself

- Written English good enough for briefs and reviews





Nice to have



- A sense for motion and interaction (scroll-based storytelling, transitions)

- A feel for typography in German text, where the words are longer and a layout that worked in English suddenly breaks

- Short-form video editing





Who should NOT apply



- Please don't apply if you are a full-stack developer or automation specialist who also does some design on the side. This is a design role, not a coding role, and we can tell the difference in your portfolio. 

- Don't apply if you are a general virtual assistant who also makes graphics. 

- Don't apply if you currently have another job or client, full-time or part-time. We need 100% commitment. 

- And don't apply if you have not yet graduated.





How to apply



Please don't message me directly here. Just fill out this short form, it takes 60 to 90 seconds:





Applications close within 2 to 3 days of posting. We are very fast.

, and Instagram).

- Produce end-to-end animated cartoon ads, from initial concept and storyboard to final render.

- Experience working with D2C e-commerce brands, understanding what drives clicks and conversions.

How to Apply?

Please submit a brief introduction along with a link to your online portfolio or demo reel.

We are prioritizing hands-on skill and output over formal degrees, so please ensure your portfolio explicitly highlights projects where you successfully integrated AI into your animation workflow.

title: Social Media Copywriter & Content Research Specialist (AI Creator Brand)
description:
Summary

Social Media Copywriter & Content Research Specialist (AI Creator Brand)



We’re looking for an elite social media copywriter and content strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch, engage, and buy.



This is not a prompt engineering role. We’re not looking for someone who copies ChatGPT or Claude outputs. We’re looking for someone who can think creatively, develop original concepts, and use AI to accelerate execution—not replace strategic thinking.



You’ll be responsible for creating high-converting content for AI influencer-style brands across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



What You’ll Do



* Research viral content daily across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Stay ahead of emerging trends before they become saturated.

* Reverse engineer high-performing creators and understand why their content works.

* Write compelling hooks that maximize retention in the first few seconds.

* Write engaging short-form video scripts.

* Create captions that drive engagement, shares, saves, and conversions.

* Develop storytelling frameworks that build trust and authority.

* Apply buyer psychology and consumer behavior to create content that influences purchasing decisions.

* Create educational, authority-building, entertainment, and sales-focused content.

* Reframe winning ideas into original content for our brands.

* Build repeatable content series instead of one-off posts.

* Collaborate with our creative team to ensure messaging aligns with visuals and brand voice.



Requirements



* Expert knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Exceptional written and spoken English.

* Outstanding copywriting skills.

* Deep understanding of:

    * Hook writing

    * Script writing

    * Storytelling

    * Consumer psychology

    * Buyer psychology

    * Sales psychology

    * Attention economics

    * Calls-to-action that convert

* Understand what drives engagement, watch time, shares, saves, and sales.

* Able to write naturally for AI influencer and creator-style brands.

* Can consistently generate original ideas without relying on AI to do the thinking.

* Strong research skills with the ability to identify trends before they become mainstream.

* Knows how to repurpose and reframe successful content into something unique.

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.



What We’re NOT Looking For



* Someone who simply prompts Claude or ChatGPT and copies the output.

* Generic copywriters with little understanding of social media.

* Writers who rely on AI to do all the thinking.

* People who chase trends without understanding strategy.

* Anyone with weak written or spoken English.



Bonus Skills



* Experience growing creator or business accounts.

* Proven examples of high-performing social media content.

* Experience writing for coaching, education, SaaS, AI, or digital products.

* Understanding of AI influencers and faceless content brands.

* Familiarity with social media analytics, retention metrics, watch time, CTR, and conversion optimization.

* Experience A/B testing hooks, captions, scripts, and messaging.



To Apply



Resumes are not required. We’re far more interested in your ability than your employment history.



Please include:



* Examples of your best hooks, captions, and scripts.

* Links to any social media accounts you’ve helped grow (if applicable).

* Examples of content you’re most proud of.

* A brief explanation of how you research trends and identify viral opportunities.

* Tell us what you believe separates content that gets views from content that generates sales.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test assignment to evaluate your content research, copywriting, hook writing, scripting, and creative thinking. We hire based on skill—not résumés.



If you’re someone who understands the psychology behind viral content, can consistently produce original ideas, and knows how to turn attention into revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Direct Response Ads for Swiss Luxury Fragrance Brand ($1,000/mo + Performance Bonuses)
description:
ABOUT ZOIS



ZOIS is a Swiss luxury fragrance house. We produce extrait-concentration perfumes in Switzerland and sell them direct-to-consumer, no retailers, no middlemen, no department stores.



We launched in 2025, scaled to seven figures across Switzerland and Germany, and recently entered the US market. We're a small, fast-moving team that ships a lot of creative.



Here's the important part: we sell through video. Our ads are the business. Every euro of revenue starts with someone stopping their scroll. That's why this role matters more here than it would at most companies and why we pay for performance instead of for hours.



THE ROLE



You'll edit direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, VSL-style ads, UGC edits, testimonial cuts, product creatives.



Full-time, long-term, remote. You'll get briefs, scripts, b-roll libraries and reaction footage from our creative team. Your job is to turn them into ads that sell.



Before you apply, look at what we actually run. This is our live ad library, sorted by impressions, the top ads are our winners. That's the standard you're editing to:





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Editing skill. Pacing, hook retention, cuts that hold attention, clean subtitles, sound design that doesn't feel like a template.

Fast communication. You reply within hours during working hours. No disappearing.

Few feedback loops. Your first version should be close to final. We don't want to art-direct every cut.

Team player. You take direction well and you're easy to work with.

You think ahead. You suggest better hooks, flag weak sections, notice when a script section drags. We want an editor with an opinion, not a button-pusher.

Direct response understanding. Hook ? problem ? mechanism ? proof ? offer ? CTA. You don't need to be an expert, we teach a lot in-house, but you need to care about why an ad converts, not just how it looks.



Tools are up to you (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci). We care about output, not software.



COMPENSATION



$1,000/month base, full-time

$50 bonus per performing video, every creative that hits our performance benchmark

Our editors who produce winners consistently add several hundred dollars per month on top of base. There is real upside here. If your creatives scale, you earn more.

Long-term position with salary reviews as you grow with us.



THE TEST REEL — REQUIRED



I only review applicants who submit the test video. No test video = no reply. This is not negotiable, so please don't apply without it.



Assets (template, b-roll, reactions):





Specs:



9:16 vertical

Burned-in subtitles

Use the provided b-roll and reaction clips; you may add your own stock, effects or AI-generated visuals

No watermarks

Upload as Google Drive / Dropbox / unlisted YouTube link



Script to edit:

-------

Wait a minute… why can't women resist this cologne?

I'm 46. And somewhere in the last ten years, I turned into furniture.

Nobody says it out loud. You just feel it. The elevator. The bar. The table next to yours. You're the guy nobody turns around for.

It's not that I stopped trying. It's that I stopped expecting anything to happen when I walked into a room.

Then a friend put a bottle of ZOIS on my desk. I thought: it's cologne. What's it going to do. That was the first thing I got wrong.

Most of what you find in a department store is around 8% fragrance oil. Two hours, gone. ZOIS is built at extrait concentration, the same oil load houses charge four hundred dollars for. It doesn't sit on your skin. It moves ahead of you. People smell you before they see you.

Week one, the woman at the counter leaned in. Week two, someone stopped me mid-sentence and asked what I was wearing. Three words I hadn't heard in eleven years.

It's not magic. It's not pheromones. Nothing in a bottle changes who you are. It just gives people a reason to pause. And when they pause, you get to be seen.

ZOIS, If nobody says a word,send it back. We'll refund it.

---------

HOW TO APPLY

Send me:



Your test video link

Your portfolio (2–3 of your best direct-response edits)

Which software you use

Your available hours and timezone (we work CET — overlap matters)

Start your message with the word EXTRAIT so I know you read the full post



Applications without a test video will not be reviewed.
