title: Senior Ecommerce Customer Experience Manager | Shopify + Gorgias
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Ecommerce Customer Experience Manager** to help us rebuild our customer support operation from the ground up.



This is **not a standard customer service representative or virtual assistant position**.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already worked inside a well-run ecommerce customer support operation and has experience managing people, building processes, improving workflows, and creating an exceptional customer experience.



We currently use **Freshdesk for
 support and Tidio for live chat**, and we are considering migrating our support operation to **Gorgias**. Strong Gorgias experience is therefore highly preferred.



Our business serves primarily US customers and fulfills products through several different manufacturers, suppliers, sellers, and fulfillment partners. Because of this, our customer support operation deals with everything from simple product questions to complicated production, shipping, customization, refund, replacement, and fulfillment issues.



Your first responsibility will be to audit our existing customer support operation and help management determine what needs to change.



You will be expected to:



* Audit customer conversations and identify weaknesses in our current customer experience

* Review our Freshdesk and Tidio workflows

* Help design a stronger overall customer support structure

* Help plan and potentially lead our migration to Gorgias

* Build tags, views, macros, rules, workflows, and automations

* Establish clear ticket ownership and escalation procedures

* Create SOPs for common customer situations

* Develop proactive follow-up systems so customers never feel forgotten

* Create systems for customers waiting on production, suppliers, replacements, or shipping

* Establish response-time, follow-up, and resolution standards

* Implement CSAT and other meaningful customer service KPIs

* Create agent QA and performance-review processes

* Train, coach, and improve the existing customer support team

* Improve communication between customer support, fulfillment, suppliers, and management

* Create clear refund, replacement, goodwill, and customer-recovery guidelines

* Help reduce negative reviews, customer complaints, and chargebacks

* Identify recurring customer problems and help management address their root causes

* Build reporting that gives management clear visibility into customer experience and agent performance



We are looking for someone with strong experience in:



* Ecommerce customer experience

* Shopify

* Gorgias

* Freshdesk

* Managing customer support teams

* Building customer support SOPs and workflows

* Helpdesk automation

* CSAT and support KPIs

* Agent coaching and QA

* Escalation management

* Refunds, replacements, returns, and order recovery

* Shipping delays and lost packages

* International fulfillment

* Supplier or 3PL coordination

* Chargebacks and disputes

* Difficult customer situations

* Proactive customer follow-up



Experience supporting **US ecommerce customers** is strongly preferred.



The ideal candidate thinks beyond simply answering tickets.



When a customer complains, we want someone who asks:



Why did this happen?



How many other customers are experiencing the same problem?

Your main responsibility is simple:



Make sure every customer request and every active project keeps moving forward without the owner having to constantly call people, chase information, or remind you what needs to be done.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Managing incoming customer requests and active jobs

* Calling suppliers and distributors

* Confirming delivery dates and pickup availability

* Communicating with technicians and installers regarding schedules and project requirements

What We Expect



We are looking for someone who does not wait to be told every individual step.



For example:



If equipment is expected to arrive tomorrow, you should check the status before the installation.



If the supplier says the equipment is delayed, you should determine the new ETA, communicate with the customer, coordinate with the field team, adjust the schedule if necessary, and update the CRM.



The owner should not have to ask:



“Did you call them?”



You should already know what needs to be followed up on.



Required Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong phone communication skills

* Excellent organization

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage many jobs and conversations at the same time

* Ability to follow up consistently

* Ability to solve routine problems independently

* Comfortable making phone calls throughout the day

* Comfortable speaking with customers, technicians, suppliers, inspectors, and government offices

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Quiet professional workspace

Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



* HVAC

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* Construction

* Home services

* Property management

* Service dispatching

* Project coordination

* Construction administration

* Customer service for U.S. companies

Work Schedule



Full-time remote position.



Schedule will generally follow California / Pacific Time business hours.

Compensation



Starting compensation depends on experience.



Expected range: Depends on experience





Strong performers who demonstrate independence, reliability, excellent customer communication, and the ability to manage projects with minimal supervision can earn more.



Who Will Be Successful in This Position



You may be a good fit if you are the type of person who:



* notices problems before someone points them out;

* likes keeping things organized;

* follows up until an issue is actually resolved;

* is comfortable calling people instead of waiting for
 replies;

* does not forget unfinished tasks;

* takes ownership of responsibilities;

title: Operations Manager | Remote
description:
Operations Manager — Full Time Remote



We’re looking for an Operations Manager to help run the daily operations of a growing online business.



This is not a VA role where you just wait for tasks. We need someone who can take responsibility for things, manage people, keep projects moving, solve problems, and make sure work actually gets done without needing to be chased constantly.



You’ll work directly with the owner and gradually take over more of the daily operations as you prove yourself.





What you’ll be doing:



• Managing remote staff and making sure people are doing what they’re supposed to do

• Helping with recruiting, screening, onboarding and replacing staff when needed

• Turning larger goals into actual tasks, deadlines and plans

• Following up on work and making sure things get finished

• Creating and improving SOPs, trackers and processes

• Coordinating between different team members

• Spotting problems before they become bigger problems

• Handling normal operational issues without immediately escalating everything

• Keeping reporting simple and making sure the important numbers and problems are visible

• Helping us plan ahead when we need more staff, capacity or resources





You won’t be expected to know everything on day one.



What matters more is that when you don’t know something, you can figure it out.





What we’re looking for:



Ideally, you’ve managed people before and have experience in operations, recruiting, remote teams, agencies, digital businesses or something similar.



More importantly, you should be someone who:



• Is organized and follows through

• Can manage people and hold them accountable

• Communicates clearly in English (C2)

• Doesn’t need step by step instructions for everything

• Can prioritize when multiple things are happening at once

• Tries to solve problems before asking someone else what to do

• Knows when to make a decision yourself and when something actually needs to be escalated

• Is comfortable with spreadsheets, trackers, project management tools and learning new software

• Likes improving systems instead of doing the same inefficient thing forever





We care more about whether you can actually run operations than whether you have the perfect resume.





Salary:



Starting salary is $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on your experience and how strong of a fit you are for the role. There will be a formal review after your first 90 days. The 90 day review is based on your actual performance, how much responsibility you’ve been able to take over, how independently you work, and how well you manage the operation. It is not an automatic salary increase after 90 days, but strong performance can lead to higher compensation, bonuses and more responsibility.



If you become someone we can genuinely rely on to run a large part of the operation, there is a lot of room to grow with the company.





Hours:



• Full time

• 40 hours per week

• Remote

• Some flexibility may occasionally be needed if something important comes up





Who this probably isn’t for:



If you need very detailed instructions for every task or prefer being told exactly what to do all day, this probably won’t be a good fit. We’re looking for someone who likes taking ownership, figuring things out, managing people and making things run better.



When applying, start your application with “Operations First” so we know you read the full post.

title: eBook Production & Amazon KDP Publishing Virtual Assistant — Research, Writing Support, Formatting & Metadata
description:
I am seeking a highly organized and experienced eBook Production Virtual Assistant to support the full Amazon KDP eBook process — from niche and keyword research through drafting support, formatting, cover coordination, metadata, and publishing.



EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY. This role requires direct, hands-on experience publishing eBooks on Amazon (Amazon KDP). Please do NOT apply or contact me if you do not have this experience — applications and messages without verifiable Amazon eBook experience will not be considered or answered.



This is not a general admin VA role. I am looking for someone who understands how to validate a niche using real Amazon demand data (not just personal opinion), help turn research and outlines into a clean manuscript, format it correctly for Kindle, and prepare a complete, compliant KDP upload package.



The role supports short, practical nonfiction eBooks — micro-guides, workbooks, and topic-based nonfiction — published individually and eventually as series once a niche proves itself.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Niche and Keyword Research

* Research Amazon Kindle Best Sellers, Movers & Shakers, autocomplete, and customer reviews to identify real reader demand

* Evaluate competition, pricing, and gaps in existing books on a topic

* Complete a niche validation scorecard (demand, competition, buyer intent, unit economics) for each proposed topic



2. Content and Manuscript Support

* Help turn research, outlines, and notes into a structured, readable manuscript

* Support drafting and revisions while preserving a clear, consistent voice

* Track manuscript versions, deadlines, and progress



3. Editing and Quality Control

* Fact-check claims and maintain a source log

* Review for grammar, clarity, originality, and consistency

* Screen for duplication and confirm the manuscript fully delivers on its title's promise



4. Formatting and Publishing Preparation

* Format manuscripts using Kindle Create, EPUB, or KPF

* Test files in Kindle Previewer across device views

* Coordinate cover design (readable at thumbnail size, correct dimensions)

* Prepare titles, subtitles, descriptions, categories, and all seven KDP keyword fields

* Assemble a complete, upload-ready KDP package



5. AI Use and Compliance

* Document which AI tools were used, what they produced, and what human verification was done

* Correctly apply Amazon's AI-generated vs. AI-assisted disclosure requirements

* Flag any copyright, trademark, or high-stakes-topic concerns before drafting begins



6. Project Management

* Maintain a clear project tracker (one card per book, with stage gates for niche ? outline ? draft ? edit ? format ? publish approval)

* Organize files by book in a consistent folder structure

* Provide regular progress updates and flag blockers early



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Direct, hands-on experience publishing eBooks on Amazon KDP — REQUIRED, minimum 2 years or 5+ published titles. Please include 3-5 books/ASINs you personally worked on and your exact role on each. Do not apply without this.

* Strong Amazon keyword and competitive research skills

* Experience with Kindle Create, EPUB/KPF, and Kindle Previewer

* Excellent written English and strong attention to detail

* Ability to distinguish verified research from unsupported AI-generated claims

* Comfortable working independently against deadlines



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* Publisher Rocket or similar keyword/category research tools

* Experience using Amazon trend and demand-research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, AMZScout, Keepa, or similar) to track rank changes, pricing history, and rising-demand topics

* Comfortable monitoring Amazon Best Sellers and Movers & Shakers movement over time to catch emerging niches early

* Understands that all research must use Amazon's public data or licensed tools — no unauthorized scraping, bots, or automated data extraction against Amazon's systems

* Cover design coordination or basic Canva skills

* Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Grammarly, or Copyscape as part of a research/QA workflow

* Experience validating and launching multiple books in parallel



AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION



Your application will be automatically rejected if you:

* Guarantee bestseller status or specific sales results

* Suggest copying, closely rewriting, or repackaging competing books

* Offer or mention fake reviews, review exchanges, or review manipulation

* Request or expect login credentials for my Amazon or KDP account

* Cannot explain Amazon's AI disclosure requirements



ACCOUNT SECURITY



You will never be asked to share, and will never be given, login credentials for my Amazon or KDP account. All work will be delivered as files for my review and upload. Any applicant who asks for account access should be treated as a scam and will not be considered.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND AI USE



All manuscripts, research, notes, outlines, and business concepts are confidential and belong to the author/company. Work may not be reused, shared, published, or placed in a portfolio without written permission. AI tools may only be used with approval, and no confidential content may be uploaded to third-party AI tools without authorization.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is a part-time, project-based remote role with potential for long-term collaboration as we validate profitable niches. Initial workload may start at approximately 5-10 hours per week and may increase. Occasional availability between 6:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time is preferred for check-ins.



COMPENSATION



This role is budgeted at $4/hour. Please confirm you are comfortable with this rate before applying. Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated ability to support niche research, manuscript quality, and KDP publishing readiness. A small paid trial project may be required before long-term work begins.



HOW TO APPLY



EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY — please do not apply or message me if you do not have verifiable Amazon KDP eBook experience. Please include the phrase "Reader Value First" in your application so I know you read the full job description. If shortlisted, you may be asked to complete a brief live screen-share walkthrough of one listed project to verify your contribution. In your response, please provide:

1. 3-5 Amazon eBooks/ASINs you personally worked on and your exact contribution to each

2. A sanitized sample of keyword or competitor research you've done

3. Your experience with Kindle Create, EPUB/KPF, and Kindle Previewer

4. The tools you use for keyword research, trend tracking, formatting, and QA

5. Your explanation of AI-generated vs. AI-assisted content and when disclosure is required

6. Your confirmation you are comfortable with the $4/hour rate and your weekly availability



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Walk me through how you would validate whether a nonfiction niche has real Amazon demand before any drafting begins.

2. Describe the exact steps you'd take to turn research notes into a 7-10 chapter outline.

3. What is your process for choosing KDP categories and the seven keyword fields for a new title?

4. What tools do you use to track Amazon trends and rising demand, and how do you use them without violating Amazon's terms of service?

5. How do you d
 whether AI-assisted content needs to be disclosed on KDP?

6. What would your first 7 days look like if hired for this role?

title: YouTube Script Writer – Full-Time / Long-Term
description:
We are looking for a talented YouTube Script Writer to join our growing content agency long-term.



We create educational YouTube content for business owners, entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts.



This is not a YouTube automation or faceless channel position.



You will be helping us write high-quality educational YouTube videos that sound natural, keep viewers interested, build trust, and help our clients grow their businesses.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Researching video topics and competitors

* Writing engaging YouTube scripts from a provided strategy and brief

* Writing strong hooks and introductions that make people want to keep watching

* Organizing ideas so videos are easy to understand and interesting to watch

* Writing in each client’s natural voice and communication style

* Using client information, research, transcripts, and other resources to create accurate scripts

* Revising scripts based on feedback

* Working with our team to consistently deliver scripts on schedule



You will not be expected to come up with the entire YouTube strategy yourself. We will provide you with direction, client information, video topics, frameworks, and training.



Who We’re Looking For



You should:



* Have excellent written English

* Be a strong researcher

* Understand how YouTube videos are structured

* Know how to write conversationally rather than like an article or school essay

* Be able to explain complicated ideas in simple language

* Understand hooks, storytelling, curiosity, and viewer retention

* Be comfortable writing about business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and e-commerce

* Be able to learn unfamiliar industries quickly

* Be reliable and communicate well

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Be comfortable receiving feedback and improving your work

* Be interested in a long-term position and growing with the company



Experience with Amazon or Amazon FBA is a big plus, as some of our content will be related to Amazon businesses.



Very Important



We are NOT looking for generic AI-generated scripts.



You can use AI as a tool for research, brainstorming, organization, and improving your work, but the final script must feel natural, thoughtful, accurate, and written specifically for the client.



If we can put the video title into ChatGPT and get basically the same script, that’s not what we’re looking for.



What We Value



We care more about the quality of your work than how many years of experience you have.



We especially value someone who is:



* A self-starter

* Detail-oriented

* Curious

* Coachable

* Dependable

* Fast without sacrificing quality

* Interested in learning YouTube and marketing at a high level



There is a big opportunity for growth in this position. As the company grows and your skills and responsibilities increase, there will be opportunities for raises and advancement.



Compensation



Starting compensation will depend on experience and writing ability.



We are open to approximately $800–$1,300 USD/month for a full-time position, with opportunities for raises based on performance, reliability, and quality of work.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your writing experience.

2. 2–3 examples of YouTube scripts you have written. If possible, include links to the published videos.

3. Tell us about your experience writing educational, business.

4. Tell us how you normally research a topic before writing a script.

5. Tell us what you think makes a YouTube hook effective.

6. Your desired monthly salary in USD.



At the very beginning of your application, write the words:



“I read the full job post.”



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a short paid writing test before we make our final hiring decision.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team, improve their skills, and grow with us long-term.
